H0001.d: a primitive word; father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
H0001.k: chief, (fore-) father(-less), [idiom] patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'.

H0003.d: from the same as H24 (אָבִיב); a green plant

H0005.d: of foreign origin; Abagtha, a eunuch of Xerxes

H0006.d: a primitive root; properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
H0006.k: break, destroy(-uction), [phrase] not escape, fail, lose, (cause to, make) perish, spend, [idiom] and surely, take, be undone, [idiom] utterly, be void of, have no way to flee.

H0007.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H6 (אָבַד) {properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)}

H0008.d: active of participle of H6 (אָבַד); (concrete) wretched or (abstract) destruction

H0009.d: from H6 (אָבַד); Compare H10 (אֲבַדֹּה). concrete, something lost; abstract, destruction, i.e. Hades

H0010.d: the same as H9 (אֲבֵדָה), miswritten for H11 (אֲבַדּוֹן); a perishing

H0011.d: intensive from H6 (אָבַד); abstract, a perishing; concrete, Hades

H0014.d: a primitive root; to breathe after, i.e. (figuratively) to be acquiescent
H0014.k: consent, rest content will, be willing.

H0016.d: from H14 (אָבָה) (in the sense of bending toward); the papyrus

H0017.d: from H14 (אָבָה) (in the sense of desiring); want

H0018.d: from H75 (אָבַס); a manger or stall

H0019.d: from an unused root (apparently meaning to turn); brandishing of a sword

H0020.d: of uncertain derivation; a melon (only plural)

H0021.d: from H1 (אָב); fatherly; Abi, Hezekiah's mother

H0022.d: from H1 (אָב) and H410 (אֵל); father (i.e. possessor) of God; Abiel, the name of two Israelites

H0023.d: from H1 (אָב) and H622 (אָסַף); father of gathering (i.e. gatherer); Abiasaph, an Israelite

H0024.d: from an unused root (meaning to be tender); green, i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan
H0024.k: Abib, ear, green ears of corn (not maize).

H0025.d: from H1 (אָב) and H1391 (גִּבְעוֹן); father (i.e. founder) of Gibon; Abi-Gibon, perhaps an Israelite

H0026.d: or shorter אֲבִיגַל; from H1 (אָב) and H1524 (גִּיל); father (i.e. source) of joy; Abigail or Abigal, the name of two Israelitesses

H0027.d: from H1 (אָב) and H1777 (דִּין); father of judgment (i.e. judge); Abidan, an Israelite

H0028.d: from H1 (אָב) and H3045 (יָדַע); father of knowledge (i.e. knowing); Abida, a son of Abraham by Keturah

H0029.d: or prolonged אֲבִיָּהוּ ; from H1 (אָב) and H3050 (יָהּ); father (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Abijah, the name of several Israelite men and two Israelitesses

H0030.d: from H1 (אָב) and H1931 (הוּא); father (i.e. worshipper) of Him (i.e. God); Abihu, a son of Aaron

H0031.d: from H1 (אָב) and H1935 (הוֹד); father (i.e. possessor) of renown; Abihud, the name of two Israelites

H0032.d: or (more correctly) אֲבִיחַיִל ; from H1 (אָב) and H2428 (חַיִל); father (i.e. possessor) of might; Abihail or Abichail, the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses

H0033.d: from H44 (אֲבִיעֶזֶר) with the article inserted; father of the Ezrite; an Abiezrite or descendant of Abiezer

H0034.d: from H14 (אָבָה), in the sense of want (especially in feeling); destitute

H0035.d: from H14 (אָבָה); provocative of desire; the caper berry (from its stimulative taste)

H0036.d: from H1 (אָב) and H2898 (טוּב); father of goodness (i.e. good); Abitub, an Israelite

H0037.d: from H1 (אָב) and H2919 (טַל); father of dew (i.e. fresh); Abital, a wife of King David

H0038.d: from H1 (אָב) and H3220 (יָם); father of (the) sea (i.e. seaman); Abijam (or Abijah), a king of Judah

H0039.d: from H1 (אָב) and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word; father of Mael (apparently some Arab tribe); Abimael, a son of Joktan

H0040.d: from H1 (אָב) and H4428 (מֶלֶךְ); father of (the) king; Abimelek, the name of two Philistine kings and of two Israelites

H0041.d: from H1 (אָב) and H5068 (נָדַב); father of generosity (i.e. liberal); Abinadab, the name of four Israelites

H0042.d: from H1 (אָב) and H5278 (נֹעַם); father of pleasantness (i.e. gracious); Abinoam, an Israelite

H0043.d: contracted from H23 (אֲבִיאָסָף); Ebjasaph, an Israelite

H0044.d: from H1 (אָב) and H5829 (עֵזֶר); father of help (i.e. helpful); Abiezer, the name of two Israelites

H0045.d: from H1 (אָב) and an unused root of uncertain derivation; probably, father of strength (i.e. valiant); Abialbon, an Israelite

H0047.k: angel, bull, chiefest, mighty (one), stout(-hearted), strong (one), valiant.

H0048.d: from H1 (אָב) and H7311 (רוּם); father of height (i.e. lofty); Abiram, the name of two Israelites

H0049.d: from H1 (אָב) and H7686 (שָׁגָה); father of error (i.e. blundering); Abishag, a concubine of David

H0050.d: from H1 (אָב) and H7771 (שׁוֹעַ); father of plenty (i.e. prosperous); Abishua, the name of two Israelites

H0051.d: from H1 (אָב) and H7791 (שׁוּר); father of (the) wall (i.e. perhaps mason); Abishur, an Israelite

H0052.d: or (shorter) אַבְשַׁי ; from H1 (אָב) and H7862 (שַׁי); father of a gift (i.e. probably generous); Abishai, an Israelite

H0053.d: or (shortened) אַבְשָׁלוֹם ; from H1 (אָב) and H7965 (שָׁלוֹם); father of peace (i.e. friendly); Abshalom, a son of David; also (the fuller form) a later Israelite

H0054.d: contracted from H1 (אָב) and H3498 (יָתַר); father of abundance (i.e. liberal); Ebjathar, an Israelite

H0055.d: a primitive root; probably to coil upward

H0058.d: from an unused root (meaning to be grassy); a meadow
H0058.k: plain. Compare also the proper names beginning with Abel-.

H0059.d: from H58 (אָבֵל); a meadow; Abel, the name of two places in Palestine.

H0061.d: apparently from H56 (אָבַל) through the idea of negation; nay, i.e. truly or yet

H0062.d: from H58 (אָבֵל) and H1004 (בַּיִת) and H4601 (מַעֲכָה); meadow of Beth-Maakah; Abel of Beth-maakah, a place in Palestine

H0063.d: from H58 (אָבֵל) and the plural of H7848 (שִׁטָּה), with the article inserted; meadow of the acacias; Abel hash-Shittim, a place in Palestine

H0064.d: from H58 (אָבֵל) and the plural of H3754 (כֶּרֶם); meadow of vineyards; Abel-Keramim, a place in Palestine

H0065.d: from H58 (אָבֵל) and H4246 (מְחֹלָה)xlit mᵉchôwlâh corrected to mᵉchôlâh; meadow of dancing; Abel-Mecholah, a place in Palestine

H0066.d: from H58 (אָבֵל) and H4325 (מַיִם); meadow of water; Abel-Majim, a place in Palestine

H0067.d: from H58 (אָבֵל) and H4714 (מִצְרַיִם); meadow of Egypt; Abel-Mitsrajim, a place in Palestine

H0068.d: from the root of H1129 (בָּנָה) through the meaning to build; a stone
H0068.k: [phrase] carbuncle, [phrase] mason, [phrase] plummet, (chalk-, hail-, head-, sling-) stone(-ny), (divers) weight(-s).

H0070.d: from the same as H68 (אֶבֶן); a pair of stones (only dual); a potter's wheel or a midwife's stool (consisting alike of two horizontal disks with a support between)

H0071.d: perhaps feminine of H68 (אֶבֶן); stony;  Compare H549 (אֲמָנָה). Abanah, a river near Damascus

H0072.d: from H68 (אֶבֶן) and H5828 (עֵזֶר) with the article inserted; stone of the help; Eben-ha-Ezer, a place in Palestine

H0074.d: or (fully) אֲבִינֵר ; from H1 (אָב) and H5216 (נִיר); father of light (i.e. enlightening); Abner, an Israelite

H0076.d: (by reduplication) from an unused root (meaning to belch forth); an inflammatory pustule (as eruption)

H0077.d: from an unused root probably meaning to gleam; conspicuous; Ebets, a place in Palestine

H0078.d: from the same as H76 (אֲבַעְבֻּעָה); splendid; Ibtsan, an Israelite

H0079.d: a primitive root, probably to float away (as vapor), but used only as denominative from H80 (אָבָק); to bedust, i.e. grapple

H0080.d: from root of H79 (אָבַק); light particles (as volatile)

H0085.d: contracted from H1 (אָב) and an unused root (probably meaning to be populous); father of a multitude; Abraham, the later name of Abram

H0086.d: probably an Egyptian word meaning kneel

H0087.d: contracted from H48 (אֲבִירָם); high father; Abram, the original name of Abraham

H0088.d: plural of H178 (אוֹב); water-skins; Oboth, a place in the Desert

H0089.d: of uncertain derivation (compare H90 (אֲגַג)); Age, an Israelite

H0090.d: or אֲגָג; of uncertain derivation (compare H89 (אָגֵא)); flame; Agag, a title of Amalekitish kings

H0091.d: patrial or patronymic from H90 (אֲגַג); an Agagite or descendent (subject) of Agag

H0092.d: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to bind); a band, bundle, knot, or arch

H0093.d: prob of Persian origin; a nut

H0094.d: passive participle of H103 (אָגַר); gathered (i.e. received among the sages); Agur, a fanciful name for Solomon

H0095.d: from the same as H94 (אָגוּר); properly, something gathered, i.e. perhaps a grain or berry; used only of a small (silver) coin

H0096.d: from an unused root (meaning to flow down or together as drops); a reservoir

H0097.d: dual of H96 (אֶגֶל).; a double pond; Eglajim, a place in Moab

H0098.d: from an unused root (meaning to collect as water); a marsh; hence a rush (as growing in swamps); hence a stockade of reeds

H0099.d: probably from the same as H98 (אֲגַם) (in the sense of stagnant water); figuratively, sad

H0100.d: from the same as H98 (אֲגַם); a marshy pool (others from a different root, a kettle); by implication a bulrush (as growing there); collectively a rope of bulrushes

H0101.d: probably from H5059 (נָגַן); a bowl (as pounded out hollow)

H0102.d: probably from H5062 (נָגַף) (through the idea of impending); a cover or heap; i.e. (only plural) wings of an army, or crowds of troops

H0104.d: (Aramaic) of Persian origin; an epistle (as carried by a state courier or postman)

H0106.d: from H1640 (גָּרַף) (in the sense of grasping); the clenched hand

H0108.d: from the same as H181 (אוּד) (in the sense of enveloping); a fog

H0110.d: probably from H109 (אָדַב) (in the sense of chastisement) and H410 (אֵל); disciplined of God; Adbeel, a son of Ishmael

H0111.d: probably an orthographical variation for H2301 (חֲדַד); Adad (or Hadad), an Edomite

H0112.d: of uncertain derivation; Iddo, an Israelite

H0113.d: or (shortened) אָדֹן; from an unused root (meaning to rule); sovereign, i.e. controller (human or divine)
H0113.k: lord, master, owner. Compare also names beginning with 'Adoni-'.

H0114.d: probably intensive for H113 (אָדוֹן); powerful; Addon, apparently an Israelite

H0115.d: dual from H142 (אָדַר) (in the sense of eminence); double mound; Adorajim, a place in Palestine

H0117.d: from H142 (אָדַר); wide or (generally) large; figuratively, powerful
H0117.k: excellent, famous, gallant, glorious, goodly, lordly, mighty(-ier one), noble, principal, worthy.

H0118.d: of Persian derivation; Adalja, a son of Haman

H0119.d: to show blood (in the face), i.e. flush or turn rosy

H0120.d: from H119 (אָדַם); ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H0120.k: [idiom] another, [phrase] hypocrite, [phrase] common sort, [idiom] low, man (mean, of low degree), person.

H0121.d: the same as H120 (אָדָם); Adam the name of the first man, also of a place in Palestine

H0123.d: or (fully) אֱדוֹם ; from H122 (אָדֹם); red (see Genesis 25:25); Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob; hence the region (Idumaea) occupied by him

H0124.d: from H119 (אָדַם); redness, i.e. the ruby, garnet, or some other red gem

H0126.d: contracted for H127 (אֲדָמָה); earthy; Admah, a place near the Dead Sea

H0127.d: from H119 (אָדַם); soil (from its general redness)

H0128.d: the same as H127 (אֲדָמָה); Adamah, a place in Palestine

H0129.d: from H127 (אֲדָמָה); earthy; Adami, a place in Palestine

H0130.d: or (fully) אֱדוֹמִי ; patronymic from H123 (אֱדֹם); See H726 (אֲרוֹמִי). an Edomite, or descendants from (or inhabitants of) Edom

H0131.d: plural of H121 (אָדָם); red spots; Adummim, a pass in Palestine

H0132.d: or (fully) אַדְמוֹנִי ; from H119 (אָדַם); reddish (of the hair or the complexion)

H0133.d: probably of Persian derivation; Admatha, a Persian nobleman

H0134.d: from the same as H113 (אָדוֹן) (in the sense of strength); a basis (of a building, a column, etc.)

H0135.d: intensive from the same as H134 (אֶדֶן); firm; Addan, an Israelite

H0136.d: an emphatic form of H113 (אָדוֹן); the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)

H0137.d: from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H966 (בֶּזֶק); lord of Bezek; Adoni-Bezek; a Canaanitish king

H0138.d: original (prolonged) אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ ; from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H3050 (יָהּ); lord (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Adonijah, the name of three Israelites

H0139.d: from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H6664 (צֶדֶק); lord of justice; Adoni-Tsedek, a Canaanitish king

H0140.d: from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H6965 (קוּם); lord of rising (i.e. high); Adonikam, the name of one or two Israelites

H0141.d: from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H7311 (רוּם); lord of height; Adoniram, an Israelite

H0142.d: a primitive root; to expand, i.e. be great or (figuratively) magnificent

H0143.d: probably of foreign derivation; perhaps meaning fire; Adar, the 12th Hebrew month

H0144.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H143 (אֲדָר) {Adar, the 12th Hebrew month}

H0145.d: from H142 (אָדַר); amplitude, i.e. (concrete) a mantle; also (figuratively) splendor

H0146.d: intensive from H142 (אָדַר); ample; Addar, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite

H0147.d: (Aramaic) intensive, from a root corresponding to H142 (אָדַר); ample, i.e. a threshing-floor

H0148.d: (Aramaic) from the same as H147 (אִדַּר), and H1505 (גְּזַר); a chief diviner, or astrologer

H0149.d: (Aramaic) probably of Persian origin; quickly or carefully

H0150.d: of Persian origin; a daric or Persian coin

H0151.d: contracted for H141 (אֲדֹנִירָם); Adoram (or Adoniram), an Israelite

H0152.d: from H142 (אָדַר) and H4428 (מֶלֶךְ); splendor of (the) king; Adrammelek, the name of an Assyrian idol, also of a son of Sennacherib

H0153.d: (Aramaic) an orthographical variation for H1872 (דְּרַע); an arm, i.e. (figuratively) power

H0154.d: from the equivalent of H153 (אֶדְרָע); mighty; Edrei, the name of two places in Palestine

H0155.d: feminine of H117 (אַדִּיר); ; also the same as H145 (אֶדֶר) something ample (as a large vine, a wide dress)

H0156.d: a primitive root; to tread out (grain)

H0157.d: or אָהֵב ; a primitive root; to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)

H0158.d: from H157 (אָהַב); affection (in a good or a bad sense)

H0159.d: from H156 (אָדַשׁ); meaning the same as H158 (אַהַב) {affection (in a good or a bad sense)}

H0160.d: feminine of H158 (אַהַב) and meaning the same {affection (in a good or a bad sense)}

H0161.d: from an unused root meaning to be united; unity; Ohad, an Israelite

H0162.d: apparently a primitive word expressing pain exclamatorily; Oh!

H0163.d: probably of foreign origin; Ahava, a river of Babylonia

H0164.d: from the same as H161 (אֹהַד); united; Ehud, the name of two or three Israelites

H0165.d: apparently an orthographical variation for H346 (אַיֵּה); where
H0165.k: I will be (Hosea 13:10,14) (which is often the rendering of the same Hebrew form from H1961 (הָיָה)).

H0166.d: a primitive root; to be clear

H0167.d: a denominative from H168 (אֹהֶל); to tent

H0168.d: from H166 (אָהַל); a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)

H0169.d: the same as H168 (אֹהֶל); Ohel, an Israelite

H0170.d: in form a feminine of H168 (אֹהֶל), but in fact for אׇהֳלָהּ; from H168 (אֹהֶל); her tent (i.e. idolatrous sanctuary); Oholah, a symbolic name for Samaria

H0171.d: from H168 (אֹהֶל) and H1 (אָב); tent of (his) father; Oholiab, an Israelite

H0172.d: (similarly with H170 (אׇהֳלָה)) for אׇהֳלִיבָהּ ; from H168 (אֹהֶל); my tent (is) in her; Oholibah, a symbolic name for Judah

H0173.d: from H168 (אֹהֶל) and H1116 (בָּמָה); tent of (the) height; Oholibamah, a wife of Esau

H0174.d: or (feminine) אֲהָלוֹת (only used thus in the plural); of foreign origin; aloe wood (i.e. sticks)

H0175.d: of uncertain derivation; Aharon, the brother of Moses

H0176.d: presumed to be the 'constructive' or genitival form of אַו ; short for H185 (אַוָּה); desire (and so probably in Proverbs 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or, also if
H0176.k: also, and, either, if, at the least, [idiom] nor, or, otherwise, then, whether.

H0177.d: from H176 (אוֹ) and H410 (אֵל); wish of God; Uel, and Israelite

H0178.d: from the same as H1 (אָב) (apparently through the idea of prattling a father's name); properly, a mumble, i.e. a water skin (from its hollow sound); hence a necromancer (ventriloquist, as from a jar)

H0179.d: probably from H56 (אָבַל); mournful; Obil, an Ishmaelite

H0180.d: or (shortened) אֻבָל ; from H2986 (יָבַל) (in the sense of H2988 (יָבָל)); a stream

H0181.d: from an unused root meaning to rake together; a poker (for turning or gathering embers)

H0182.d: or (shortened) אֹדוֹת (only thus in the plural); from the same as H181 (אוּד); turnings (i.e. occasions); (adverb) on account of

H0183.d: a primitive root; to wish for
H0183.k: covet, (greatly) desire, be desirous, long, lust (after).

H0184.d: a primitive root; to extend or mark out

H0186.d: perhaps by permutation for H5813 (עֻזִּי), strong; Uzai, an Israelite

H0187.d: of uncertain derivation; Uzal, a son of Joktan

H0188.d: probably from H183 (אָוָה) (in the sense of crying out after); lamentation; also interjectionally Oh!

H0189.d: probably from H183 (אָוָה); desirous; Evi, a Midianitish chief

H0190.d: feminine of H188 (אוֹי) {lamentation; also interjectionally Oh!}

H0191.d: from an unused root (meaning to be perverse); (figuratively) silly

H0192.d: of Aramaic derivation and probably meaning soldier of Merodak; Evil-Merodak, a Babylonian king

H0193.d: from an unused root meaning to twist, i.e. (by implication) be strong; the body (as being rolled together); also powerful

H0194.d: or (shortened) אֻלַי; from H176 (אוֹ); if not; hence perhaps
H0194.k: if so be, may be, peradventure, unless.

H0195.d: of Persian derivation; the Ulai (or Eulaeus), a river of Persia

H0196.d: from H191 (אֱוִיל); silly, foolish; hence (morally) impious

H0197.d: or (shortened), אֻלָם ; from H481 (אָלַם) (in the sense of tying); a vestibule (as bound to the building)

H0198.d: appar, from H481 (אָלַם) (in the sense of dumbness); solitary; Ulam, the name of two Israelites

H0199.d: apparently a variation of H194 (אוּלַי); however or on the contrary
H0199.k: as for, but, howbeit, in very deed, surely, truly, wherefore.

H0200.d: from the same as H191 (אֱוִיל); silliness

H0201.d: from H559 (אָמַר); talkative; Omar, a grandson of Esau

H0202.d: probably from the same as H205 (אָוֶן) (in the sense of effort, but successful); ability, power, (figuratively) wealth

H0203.d: the same as H202 (אוֹן); On, an Israelite

H0204.d: or (shortened); אֹן; of Egyptian derivation; On, a city of Egypt

H0205.d: from an unused root perhaps meaning properly, to pant (hence, to exert oneself, usually in vain; to come to naught); strictly nothingness; also trouble. vanity, wickedness; specifically an idol
H0205.k: affliction, evil, false, idol, iniquity, mischief, mourners(-ing), naught, sorrow, unjust, unrighteous, vain, vanity, wicked(-ness). Compare H369 (אַיִן).

H0206.d: the same as H205 (אָוֶן); idolatry; Aven, the contemptuous synonym of three places, one in Coele-Syria, one in Egypt (On), and one in Palestine (Bethel)
H0206.k: Aven. See also H204 (אוֹן), H1007 (בֵּית אָוֶן).

H0207.d: or (shortened) אֹנוֹ; prolonged from H202 (אוֹן); strong; Ono, a place in Palestine

H0208.d: a variation of H209 (אוֹנָן); strong; Onam, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite

H0209.d: a variation of H207 (אוֹנוֹ); strong; Onan, a son of Judah

H0210.d: perhaps a corruption of H211 (אוֹפִיר); Uphaz, a famous gold region

H0211.d: or (shortened) אֹפִיר; and אוֹפִר; of uncertain derivation; Ophir, the name of a son of Joktan, and of a gold region in the East

H0212.d: or (shortened) אֹפָן; from an unused root meaning to revolve; a wheel

H0828.d: of foreign origin; Ashpenaz, a Babylonian eunuch

H0829.d: of uncertain derivation; a measured portion

H0830.d: or אַשְׁפּוֹת; or שְׁפֹת; (contraction) plural of a noun of the same form as H827 (אַשְׁפָּה), from H8192 (שָׁפָה) (in the sense of scraping); a heap of rubbish or filth

H0831.d: probably from H8254 (שָׁקַל) in the sense of weighing-place (i.e. mart); Ashkelon, a place in Palestine

H0832.d: patrial from H831 (אַשְׁקְלוֹן); Ashkelonite (collectively) or inhabitant of Ashkelon

H0833.d: or אָשֵׁר; a primitive root; to be straight (used in the widest sense, especially to be level, right, happy); figuratively, to go forward, be honest, proper
H0833.k: (call, be) bless(-ed, happy), go, guide, lead, relieve.

H0834.d: a primitive relative pronoun (of every gender and number); who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H0834.k: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

H0835.d: from H833 (אָשַׁר); happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!

H0836.d: from H833 (אָשַׁר), happy; Asher, a son of Jacob, and the tribe descended from him, with its territory; also a place in Palestine

H0838.d: or אַשֻּׁר; from H833 (אָשַׁר) in the sense of going; a step

H0839.d: contracted for H8391 (תְּאַשּׁוּר); the cedar tree or some other light elastic wood

H0840.d: by orthographical variation from H833 (אָשַׁר) and H410 (אֵל); right of God; Asarel, an Israelite

H0841.d: from the same as H840 (אֲשַׂרְאֵל); right toward God; Asarelah, an Israelite

H0842.d: or אֲשֵׁירָה; from H833 (אָשַׁר); happy; Asherah (or Astarte) a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same

H0843.d: patronymic from H836 (אָשֵׁר); an Asherite (collectively) or descendant of Asher

H0844.d: an orthographical variation for H840 (אֲשַׂרְאֵל); Asriel, the name of two Israelites

H0845.d: patronymic from H844 (אַשְׂרִיאֵל); an Asrielite (collectively) or descendant of Asriel

H0846.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H833 (אָשַׁר); a wall (from its uprightness)

H0847.d: or אֶשְׁתָּאוֹל; probably from H7592 (שָׁאַל); intreaty; Eshtaol, a place in Palestine

H0848.d: patrial from H847 (אֶשְׁתָּאֹל); an Eshtaolite (collectively) or inhabitant of Eshtaol

H0849.d: (Aramaic) from H7712 (שְׁדַר) (in a bad sense); rebellion

H0850.d: probably from the same as H7764 (שׁוּנִי); restful; Eshton, an Israelite

H0851.d: or אֶשְׁתְּמוֹעַ; or אֶשְׁתְּמֹה; from H8085 (שָׁמַע) (in the sense of obedience); Eshtemoa or Eshtemoh, a place in Palestine

H0853.d: apparent contracted from H226 (אוֹת) in the demonstrative sense of entity; properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)

H0854.d: probably from H579 (אָנָה); properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
H0854.k: against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.

H0855.d: of uncertain derivation; a hoe or other digging implement

H0856.d: from H854 (אֵת) and H1168 (בַּעַל); with Baal; Ethbaal, a Phoenician king

H0857.d: or אָתָא; a primitive root (collateral to H225 (אוּת) contraction); to arrive

H0858.d: (Aramaic) or אָתָא; (Aramaic), corresponding to H857 (אָתָה) {to arrive}

H0859.d: or (shortened); אַתָּ; or אַת; feminine (irregular) sometimes אַתִּי; plural masculine אַתֶּם; feminine אַתֶּן; or אַתֵּנָהlemma אתֵּנָה missing vowel, corrected to אַתֵּנָה; or אַתֵּנָּה; a primitive pronoun of the second person; thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you

H0860.d: probably from the same as H386 (אֵיתָן) (in the sense of patience); a female donkey (from its docility)

H0861.d: (Aramaic) probably from the corresponding to H784 (אֵשׁ); probably a fire-place, i.e. furnace

H0862.d: or אַתִּיק; from H5423 (נָתַק) in the sense of decreasing; a ledge or offset in abuilding

H0863.d: or אִיתַי; from H854 (אֵת); near; Ittai or Ithai, the name of a Gittite and of an Israelite

H0864.d: of Egyptian derivation; Etham, a place in the Desert

H0865.d: or אִתְמוֹל; or אֶתְמוּל; probably from H853 (אֵת) or H854 (אֵת) and H4136 (מוּל); heretofore; definitely yesterday
H0865.k: [phrase] before (that) time, [phrase] heretofore, of late (old), [phrase] times past, yester(day).

H0866.d: from H8566 (תָּנָה); a present (as the price of harlotry)

H0867.d: perhaps from H866 (אֶתְנָה); munificence; Ethni, an Israelite

H0868.d: the same as H866 (אֶתְנָה); a gift (as the price of harlotry or idolatry)

H0869.d: the same as H868 (אֶתְנַן) in the sense of H867 (אֶתְנִי); Ethnan, an Israelite

H0870.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of H871 (אֲתָרִים); a place; (adverb) after

H0871.d: plural from an unused root (probably meaning to step); places; Atharim, a place near Palestine

H0872.d: from H935 (בּוֹא); an entrance to a building

H0874.d: a primitive root; to dig; by analogy, to engrave; figuratively, to explain

H0875.d: from H874 (בָּאַר); a pit; especially a well

H0876.d: the same as H875 (בְּאֵר); Beer, a place in the Desert, also one in Palestine

H0878.d: from H875 (בְּאֵר); a well; Beera, an Israelite

H0879.d: from H875 (בְּאֵר) and the plural of H410 (אֵל); well of heroes; Beer-Elim, a place in the Desert

H0880.d: the same as H878 (בְּאֵרָא); Beerah, an Israelite

H0881.d: feminine plural of H875 (בְּאֵר); wells; Beeroth, a place in Palestine

H0882.d: from H875 (בְּאֵר); fountained; Beeri, the name of a Hittite and of an Israelite

H0883.d: from H875 (בְּאֵר) and H2416 (חַי) (with prefix) and H7203 (רֹאֶה); well of a living (One) my Seer; Beer-Lachai-Roi, a place in the Desert

H0884.d: from H875 (בְּאֵר) and H7651 (שֶׁבַע) (in the sense of H7650 (שָׁבַע)); well of an oath; Beer-Sheba, a place in Palestine

H0885.d: from the feminine plural of H875 (בְּאֵר), and the plural contraction of H1121 (בֵּן), and H3292 (יַעֲקָן); wells of (the) sons of Jaakan; Beeroth-Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert
H0885.k: Beeroth of the children of Jaakan.

H0886.d: patrial from H881 (בְּאֵרוֹת); a Beerothite or inhabitant of Beeroth

H0887.d: a primitive root; to smell bad; figuratively, to be offensive morally
H0887.k: (make to) be abhorred (had in abomination, loathsome, odious), (cause a, make to) stink(-ing savour), [idiom] utterly.

H0888.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H887 (בָּאַשׁ) {to smell bad; figuratively, to be offensive morally}

H0890.d: feminine of H889 (בְּאֹשׁ); stink-weed or any other noxious or useless plant

H0892.d: feminine active participle of an unused root meaning to hollow out; something hollowed (as a gate), i.e. pupil of the eye

H0893.d: probably of foreign origin; Bebai, an Israelite

H0894.d: from H1101 (בָּלַל); confusion; Babel (i.e. Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire

H0895.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H894 (בָּבֶל) {Babel (i.e. Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire}

H0898.d: a primitive root; to cover (with a garment); figuratively, to act covertly; by implication, to pillage
H0898.k: deal deceitfully (treacherously, unfaithfully), offend, transgress(-or), (depart), treacherous (dealer, -ly, man), unfaithful(-ly, man), [idiom] very.

H0899.d: from H898 (בָּגַד); a covering, i.e. clothing; also treachery or pillage
H0899.k: apparel, cloth(-es, ing), garment, lap, rag, raiment, robe, [idiom] very (treacherously), vesture, wardrobe.

H0900.d: feminine plural active participle of H898 (בָּגַד); treacheries

H0902.d: probably of foreign origin; Bigvai, an Israelite

H0903.d: of Persian derivation; Bigtha, a eunuch of Xerxes

H0904.d: or בִּגְתָנָא; of similar derivation to H903 (בִּגְתָא); Bigthan or Bigthana, a eunuch of Xerxes

H0905.d: from H909 (בָּדַד); properly, separation; by implication, a part of the body, branch of atree, bar forcarrying; figuratively, chief of a city; especially (with prepositional prefix) as an adverb, apart, only, besides
H0905.k: alone, apart, bar, besides, branch, by self, of each alike, except, only, part, staff, strength.

H0906.d: perhaps from H909 (בָּדַד) (in the sense of divided fibres); flaxen thread or yarn; hence, a linen garment

H0907.d: from H908 (בָּדָא); a brag or lie; also a liar

H0909.d: a primitive root; to divide, i.e. (reflex.) be solitary

H0911.d: from H909 (בָּדַד); separation; Bedad, an Edomite

H0912.d: probably a shortened form H5662 (עֹבַדְיָה); servant of Jehovah; Bedejah, an Israelite

H0913.d: from H914 (בָּדַל); alloy (because removed by smelting); by analogy, tin

H0914.d: a primitive root; to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.)
H0914.k: (make, put) difference, divide (asunder), (make) separate (self, -ation), sever (out), [idiom] utterly.

H0916.d: probably from H914 (בָּדַל); something in pieces, i.e. bdellium, a (fragrant) gum (perhaps amber); others a pearl

H0917.d: probably shortened for H5658 (עַבְדוֹן); servile; Bedan, the name of two Israelites

H0918.d: a primitive root; to gap open; used only as a denominative from H919 (בֶּדֶק); to mend a breach

H0919.d: from H918 (בָּדַק); a gap or leak (in a building or a ship)

H0920.d: probably from H1856 (דָּקַר) with a prepositional prefix; by stabbing, i.e. assassin; Bidkar, an Israelite

H0921.d: (Aramaic) corresponding (by transposition) to H6504 (פָּרַד); to scatter

H0922.d: from an unused root (meaning to be empty); a vacuity, i.e. (superficially) an undistinguishable ruin

H0923.d: from an unused root (probably meaning to glisten); white marble or perhaps alabaster

H0924.d: (Aramaic) from H927 (בְּהַל); a hurry; only adverb, hastily

H0925.d: from an unused root (meaning to be bright); shining

H0926.d: a primitive root; to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously
H0926.k: be (make) affrighted (afraid, amazed, dismayed, rash), (be, get, make) haste(-n, -y, -ily), (give) speedy(-ily), thrust out, trouble, vex.

H0927.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H926 (בָּהַל); to terrify, hasten

H0929.d: from an unused root (probably meaning to be mute); properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective)

H0930.d: in form a plural or H929 (בְּהֵמָה), but really a singular of Egyptian derivation; a water-ox, i.e. the hippopotamus or Nile-horse

H0931.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to be thick; the thumb of the hand or great toe of the foot

H0932.d: an orthographical variation of H931 (בֹּהֶן); thumb, Bohan, an Israelite

H0933.d: from an unused root meaning to be pale; white scurf

H0934.d: feminine active participle of the same as H925 (בָּהִיר); a whitish spot on the skin

H0935.d: a primitive root; to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H0935.k: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.

H0938.d: the same as H937 (בּוּז); Buz, the name of a son of Nahor, and of an Israelite

H0939.d: feminine passive participle of H936 (בּוּז); something scorned; an object of contempt

H0940.d: patronymic from H938 (בּוּז); a Buzite or descendant of Buz

H0941.d: the same as H940 (בּוּזִי); Buzi, an Israelite

H0942.d: probably of Persian origin; Bavvai, an Israelite

H0943.d: a primitive root; to involve (literally or figuratively)

H0944.d: for H2981 (יְבוּל); produce (of the earth, etc.)

H0945.d: the same as H944 (בּוּל) (in the sense of rain); Bul, the eighth Hebrew month

H0946.d: from H995 (בִּין); discretion; Bunah, an Israelite

H0947.d: a primitive root; to trample (literally or figuratively)

H0948.d: from an unused root (of the same form) meaning to bleach, i.e. (intransitive) be white; probably cotton (of some sort)

H0949.d: from the same as H948 (בּוּץ); shining; Botsets, a rock near Michmash

H0950.d: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to be hollow); emptiness (as adjective)

H0951.d: properly, active participle from H1239 (בָּקַר) as denominative from H1241 (בָּקָר); a cattle-tender

H0952.d: a primitive root; to bore, i.e. (figuratively) examine

H0953.d: from H952 (בּוּר) (in the sense of H877 (בֹּאר)); a pit hole (especially one used as a cistern or a prison)

H0954.d: a primitive root; properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed
H0954.k: (be, make, bring to, cause, put to, with, a-) shamed(-d), be (put to) confounded(-fusion), become dry, delay, be long.

H0955.d: feminine participle passive of H954 (בּוּשׁ); shame

H0956.d: (Aramaic) apparent denominative from H1005 (בַּיִת); to lodge over night

H0958.d: a primitive root; probably to cleave

H0959.k: despise, disdain, contemn(-ptible), [phrase] think to scorn, vile person.

H0962.k: catch, gather, (take) for a prey, rob(-ber), spoil, take (away, spoil), [idiom] utterly.

H0964.d: from H959 (בָּזָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); contempts of Jah; Bizjothjah, a place in Palestine

H0965.d: from an unused root meaning to lighten; a flash of lightning

H0966.d: from H965 (בָּזָק); lightning; Bezek, a place in Palestine

H0968.d: of Persian origin; Biztha, a eunuch of Xerxes

H0969.d: from H974 (בָּחַן); an assayer or metals

H0970.d: or בָּחֻר; participle passive of H977 (בָּחַר); properly, selected, i.e. a youth (often collective)

H0971.d: another form of H975 (בַּחַן); a watch-tower of besiegers

H0973.k: abhor, get hastily (from the margin for H926 (בָּהַל)).

H0974.d: a primitive root; to test (especially metals); generally and figuratively, to investigate

H0975.d: from H974 (בָּחַן) (in the sense of keeping a look-out); a watch-tower

H0977.d: a primitive root; properly, to try, i.e. (by implication) select
H0977.k: acceptable, appoint, choose (choice), excellent, join, be rather, require.

H0978.d: patrial from H980 (בַּחֻרִים) (by transposition); a Bacharumite or inhabitant of Bachurim

H0979.d: or בְּחוּרוֹת; feminine plural of H970 (בָּחוּר); also (masculine plural) בְּחֻרִים; youth (collectively and abstractly)

H0980.d: or בַּחוּרִים; masculine plural of H970 (בָּחוּר); young men; Bachurim, a place in Palestine

H0981.d: or בָּטָה; a primitive root; to babble; hence, to vociferate angrily

H0982.d: a primitive root; properly, to hide for refuge (but not so precipitately as H2620 (חָסָה)); figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
H0982.k: be bold (confident, secure, sure), careless (one, woman), put confidence, (make to) hope, (put, make to) trust.

H0983.d: from H982 (בָּטַח); properly, a place of refuge; abstract, safety, both the fact (security) and the feeling (trust); often (adverb with or without preposition) safely
H0983.k: assurance, boldly, (without) care(-less), confidence, hope, safe(-ly, -ty), secure, surely.

H0984.d: the same as H983 (בֶּטַח); Betach, a place in Syria

H0988.d: a primitive root; to desist from labor

H0990.d: from an unused root probably meaning to be hollow; the belly, especially the womb; also the bosom or body of anything
H0990.k: belly, body, [phrase] as they be born, [phrase] within, womb.

H0991.d: the same as H990 (בֶּטֶן); Beten. a place in Palestine

H0992.d: from H990 (בֶּטֶן); (only in plural) a pistachio-nut (from its form)

H0993.d: probably plural from H992 (בֹּטֶן); hollows; Betonim, a place in Palestine

H0994.d: perhaps from H1158 (בָּעָה) (in the sense of asking); properly, a request; used only adverbially (always with 'my Lord'); oh that!; with leave, or if it please

H0995.d: a primitive root; to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand
H0995.k: attend, consider, be cunning, diligently, direct, discern, eloquent, feel, inform, instruct, have intelligence, know, look well to, mark, perceive, be prudent, regard, (can) skill(-full), teach, think, (cause, make to, get, give, have) understand(-ing), view, (deal) wise(-ly, man).

H0996.d: (sometimes in the plural masculine or feminine); properly, the constructive form of an otherwise unused noun from H995 (בִּין); a distinction; but used only as a preposition, between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or
H0996.k: among, asunder, at, between (-twixt...and), [phrase] from (the widest), [idiom] in, out of, whether (it be...or), within.

H0997.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H996 (בֵּין) {between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or}

H1000.d: from the same as H948 (בּוּץ); an egg (from its whiteness)

H1002.d: of foreign origin; a castle or palace

H1004.d: probably from H1129 (בָּנָה) abbreviated; a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H1004.k: court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).

H1005.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H1004 (בַּיִת) {a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)}

H1006.d: the same as H1004 (בַּיִת); Bajith, a place in Palestine

H1007.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H205 (אָוֶן); house of vanity; Beth-Aven, a place in Palestine

H1008.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H410 (אֵל); house of God; Beth-El, a place in Palestine

H1009.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H695 (אֶרֶב) and H410 (אֵל); house of God's ambush; Beth-Arbel, a place in Palestine

H1010.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H1168 (בַּעַל) and H4583 (מָעוֹן); house of Baal of (the) habitation of (apparently by transposition); or (shorter) בֵּית מְעוֹןlemma בֵּית מעוֹן missing vowel, corrected to בֵּית מְעוֹן; house of habitation of (Baal); Beth-Baal-Meon, a place in Palestine
H1010.k: Beth-baal-meon. Compare H1186 (בַּעַל מְעוֹן) and H1194 (בְּעֹן).

H1011.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H1254 (בָּרָא); house of a creative one; Beth-Biri, a place in Palestine

H1012.d: probably from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H5679 (עֲבָרָה); house of (the) ford; Beth-Barah, a place in Palestine

H1013.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H1447 (גָּדֵר); house of (the) wall; Beth-Gader, a place in Palestine

H1014.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the passive participle of H1576 (גְּמוּל); house of (the) weaned; Beth-Gamul, a place East of the Jordan

H1015.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the dual of H1690 (דְּבֵלָה); house of (the) two figcakes; Beth-Diblathajim, a place East of the Jordan

H1016.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H1712 (דָּגוֹן); house of Dagon; Beth-Dagon, the name of two places in Palestine

H1017.d: patrial from H1008 (בֵּית־אֵל) with the article interposed; a Beth-elite, or inhabitant of Bethel

H1018.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H681 (אֵצֶל) with the article interposed; house of the side; Beth-ha-Etsel, a place in Palestine

H1019.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H1537 (גִּלְגָּל) with the article interposed; house of Gilgal (or rolling); Beth-hag-Gilgal, a place in Palestine

H1020.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the plural of H3451 (יְשִׁימַה) with the article interposed; house of the deserts; Beth-ha-Jeshimoth, a town East of the Jordan

H1021.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H3754 (כֶּרֶם) with the article interposed; house of the vineyard; Beth-hak-Kerem, a place in Palestine

H1022.d: patrial from H1035 (בֵּית לֶחֶם) with the article inserted; a Beth-lechemite, or native of Bethlechem

H1033.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H3733 (כַּר); house of pasture; Beth-Car, a place in Palestine

H1038.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H4601 (מַעֲכָה); house of Maakah; Beth-Maakah, a place in Palestine

H1051.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H7497 (רָפָא); house of (the) giant; Beth-Rapha, an Israelite

H1073.d: by orthographical variation for H1063 (בִּכּוּרָה); a first-ripe fig

H1077.k: lest, neither, no, none (that...), not (any), nothing.

H1079.d: (Aramaic) from H1080 (בְּלָא); properly, anxiety, i.e. (by implication) the heart (as its seat)

H1081.d: from H1078 (בֵּל) and H113 (אָדוֹן) (contracted); Bel (is his) lord; Baladan, the name of a Babylonian prince

H1085.d: of uncertain derivation; Bildad, one of Job's friends

H1086.d: a primitive root; to fail; by implication to wear out, decay (causatively, consume, spend)

H1088.d: feminine of H1087 (בָּלֶה); failure; Balah, a place in Palestine

H1089.d: a primitive root (rather by transposition for H926 (בָּהַל)); to palpitate; hence, (causatively) to terrify

H1090.d: from H1089 (בָּלַהּ); timid; Bilhah, the name of one of Jacob's concubines; also of a place in Palestine

H1092.d: from H1089 (בָּלַהּ); timid; Bilhan, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite

H1093.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H1086 (בָּלָה); excise (on articles consumed)

H1094.d: or (fully) בְּלוֹי; from H1086 (בָּלָה); (only in plural construction) rags

H1096.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H1095 (בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר) {Belteshatstsar, the Babylonian name of Daniel}

H1098.d: from H1101 (בָּלַל); mixed, i.e. (specifically) feed (for cattle)

H1106.d: the same as H1105 (בֶּלַע); Bela, the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two Israelites

H1113.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H1112 (בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר) {Belshatstsar, a Babylonian king}

H1114.d: of uncertain derivation; Bilshan, an Israelite

H1116.d: from an unused root (meaning to be high); an elevation

H1123.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H1121 (בֵּן) {a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense}

H1124.d: (Aramaic) or בְּנָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to H1129 (בָּנָה); to build

H1126.d: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H205 (אָוֶן); son of my sorrow; Ben-Oni, the original name of Benjamin

H1129.d: a primitive root; to build (literally and figuratively)

H1130.d: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H1908 (הֲדַד); son of Hadad; Ben-Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings

H1131.d: from H1129 (בָּנָה); built up; Binnui, an Israelite

H1132.d: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2105 (זוֹחֵת); son of Zocheth; Ben-Zocheth, an Israelite

H1133.d: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2354 (חוּר); son of Chur; Ben-Chur, an Israelite

H1134.d: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2428 (חַיִל); son of might; Ben-Chail, an Israelite

H1135.d: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2605 (חָנָן); son of Chanan; Ben-Chanan, an Israelite

H1136.d: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2617 (חֵסֵד); son of kindness; Ben-Chesed, an Israelite

H1137.d: from H1129 (בָּנָה); built; Bani, the name of five Israelites

H1138.d: or (fuller) בּוּנִי; from H1129 (בָּנָה); built; Bunni or Buni, an Israelite

H1139.d: from the plural construction of H1121 (בֵּן) and H1300 (בָּרָק); sons of lightning, Bene-berak, a place in Palestine

H1141.d: or בּנָיָהוּ; (prolonged) from H1129 (בָּנָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has built; Benajah, the name of twelve Israelites

H1142.d: from the plural of H1121 (בֵּן) and H3292 (יַעֲקָן); sons of Yaakan; Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert

H1148.d: probably from H1121 (בֵּן) with pron. suff.; our son; Beninu, an Israelite

H1149.d: (Aramaic) of uncertain affinity; to be enraged

H1150.d: or בִּנְעָה; of uncertain derivation; Bina or Binah, an Israelite

H1151.d: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H5971 (עַם) with pronomial suffix; son of my people; Ben-Ammi, a son of Lot

H1152.d: from H5475 (סוֹד) and H3050 (יָהּ) with prepositional prefix; in (the) counsel of Jehovah; Besodejah, an Israelite

H1153.d: from H947 (בּוּס); domineering; Besai, one of the Nethinim

H1154.d: from an unused root meaning to be sour; an immature grape

H1155.d: from the same as H1154 (בֶּסֶר) {an immature grape}

H1156.d: (Aramaic) or בְּעָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to H1158 (בָּעָה); to seek or ask
H1156.k: ask, desire, make (petition), pray, request, seek.

H1157.d: from H5704 (עַד) with prepositional prefix; in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.
H1157.k: about, at by (means of), for, over, through, up (-on), within.

H1158.d: a primitive root; to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask

H1160.d: from H1197 (בָּעַר) (in the sense of burning); a lamp; Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king; also of that of Balaam

H1162.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple

H1163.d: a primitive root; to trample down, i.e. (figuratively) despise

H1165.d: from H1197 (בָּעַר) (in the sense of eating); cattle

H1166.d: a primitive root; also as denominative from H1167 (בַּעַל) to be master; hence, to marry

H1169.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H1167 (בַּעַל) {a master; hence, a husband,}

H1170.d: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H1285 (בְּרִית); Baal of (the) covenant; Baal-Berith, a special deity of the Shechemites

H1171.d: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H1409 (גָּד); Baal of Fortune; Baal-Gad, a place in Syria

H1173.d: the same as H1172 (בַּעֲלָה); Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine

H1174.d: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H1995 (הָמוֹן); possessor of a multitude; Baal-Hamon, a place in Palestine

H1175.d: plural of H1172 (בַּעֲלָה); mistresses; Bealoth, a place in Palestine
H1175.k: Bealoth, in Aloth (by mistake for a plural from H5927 (עָלָה) with prepositional prefix).

H1176.d: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H2070 (זְבוּב); Baal of (the) Fly; Baal-Zebub, a special deity of the Ekronites

H1177.d: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H2603 (חָנַן); possessor of grace; Baal-Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite

H1178.d: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and a modification of H2691 (חָצֵר); possessor of a village; Baal-Chatsor, a place in Palestine

H1179.d: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H2768 (חֶרְמוֹן); possessor of Hermon; Baal-Chermon, a place in Palestine

H1180.d: from H1167 (בַּעַל) with pron. suff.; my master; Baali, a symbolical name for Jehovah

H1181.d: from the plural of H1168 (בַּעַל) and the plural of H1116 (בָּמָה); Baals of (the) heights; Baale-Bamoth, a place East of the Jordan

H2696.d: from H2691 (חָצֵר); court-yard; Chetsron, the name of a place in Palestine; also of two Israelites

H2697.d: patronymically from H2696 (חֶצְרוֹן); a Chetsronite or (collectively) descendants of Chetsron

H2698.d: feminine plural of H2691 (חָצֵר); yards; Chatseroth, a place in Palestine

H2699.d: plural masculine of H2691 (חָצֵר); yards; Chatserim, a place in Palestine

H2700.d: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H4194 (מָוֶת); village of death; Chatsarmaveth, a place in Arabia

H2701.d: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H5484 (סוּסָה); village of cavalry; Chatsar-Susah, a place in Palestine

H2702.d: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and the plural of H5483 (סוּס); village of horses; Chatsar-Susim, a place in Palestine

H2703.d: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and a derivative of H5869 (עַיִן); village of springs; Chatsar-Enon, a place in Palestine

H2704.d: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and the same as H5881 (עֵינָן); village of springs; Chatsar-Enan, a place in Palestine

H2705.d: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H7776 (שׁוּעָל); village of (the) fox; Chatsar-Shual, a place in Palestine

H2706.d: from H2710 (חָקַק); an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage)

H2707.d: a primitive root; to carve; by implication, to delineate; also to entrench
H2707.k: carved work, portrayed, set a print.

H2708.d: feminine of H2706 (חֹק), and meaning substantially the same {an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage)}
H2708.k: appointed, custom, manner, ordinance, site, statute.

H2709.d: from an unused root probably meaning to bend; crooked; Chakupha, one of the Nethinim

H2710.k: appoint, decree, governor, grave, lawgiver, note, pourtray, print, set.

H2711.d: from H2710 (חָקַק); an enactment, a resolution

H2712.d: or (fully) חוּקֹק; from H2710 (חָקַק); appointed; Chukkok or Chukok, a place in Palestine

H2713.d: a primitive root; properly, to penetrate; hence, to examine intimately
H2713.k: find out, (make) search (out), seek (out), sound, try.

H2715.d: or (fully) חוֹר; from H2787 (חָרַר); (compare H2751 (חֹרִי)) properly, white or pure (from the cleansing or shining power of fire; hence (figuratively) noble (in rank)

H2716.d: from an unused (and vulgar) root probably meaning to evacuate the bowels; excrement

H2717.d: or חֲרֵב; a primitive root; to parch (through drought) i.e. (by analogy,) to desolate, destroy, kill

H2718.d: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to H2717 (חָרַב); to demolish

H2719.d: from H2717 (חָרַב); drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement

H2721.k: desolation, drought, dry, heat, [idiom] utterly, waste.

H2722.d: from H2717 (חָרַב); desolate; Choreb, a (generic) name for the Sinaitic mountains

H2723.d: feminine of H2721 (חֹרֶב); properly, drought, i.e. (by implication) a desolation

H2726.d: or חַרְבוֹנָה; of Persian origin; Charbona or Charbonah, a eunuch of Xerxes

H2727.d: a primitive root; properly, to leap suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to be dismayed

H2728.d: from H2727 (חָרַג); the leaping insect, i.e. a locust

H2729.d: a primitive root; to shudder with terror; hence, to fear; also to hasten (with anxiety)
H2729.k: be (make) afraid, be careful, discomfit, fray (away), quake, tremble.

H2733.d: patrial from a derivative of H2729 (חָרַד) (compare H5878 (עֵין חֲרֹד)); a Charodite, or inhabitant of Charod

H2736.d: ; from H2734 (חָרָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); fearing Jah; Charhajah, an Israelite

H2737.d: from an unused root meaning to perforate; properly, pierced, i.e. a bead of pearl, gems or jewels (as strung)

H2738.d: or (shortened) חָרֻל; apparently, a passive participle of an unused root probably meaning to be prickly; properly, pointed, i.e. a bramble or other thorny weed

H2739.d: from passive participle of H2763 (חָרַם) and H639 (אַף); snub-nosed; Charumaph, an Israelite

H2740.d: or (shortened) חָרֹן; from H2734 (חָרָה); a burning of anger

H2741.d: a patrial from (probably) a collateral form of H2756 (חָרִיף); a Charuphite or inhabitant of Charuph (or Chariph)

H2742.d: or חָרֻץ; passive participle of H2782 (חָרַץ); properly, incised or (active) incisive; hence (as noun masculine or feminine) a trench (as dug), gold (as mined), a threshing-sledge (having sharp teeth); (figuratively) determination; also eager
H2742.k: decision, diligent, (fine) gold, pointed things, sharp, threshing instrument, wall.

H2743.d: the same as H2742 (חֲרוּץ); earnest; Charuts, an Israelite

H2744.d: a fuller form of H2746 (חַרְחֻר); inflammation; Charchur, one of the Nethinim

H2745.d: from the same as H2775 (חֶרֶס); perhaps shining; Charchas, an Israelite

H2747.d: from a primitive root meaning to engrave; a chisel or graver; also a style forwriting

H2748.d: from the same as H2747 (חֶרֶט); a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles)

H2749.d: (Aramaic) the same as H2748 (חַרְטֹם) {a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles)}

H2750.d: from H2734 (חָרָה); a burning (i.e. intense) anger

H2751.d: from the same as H2353 (חוּר); white bread

H2752.d: from H2356 (חוֹר); cave-dweller or troglodyte; a Chorite or aboriginal Idumaean

H2753.d: or חוֹרִי; the same as H2752 (חֹרִי); Chori, the name of two men

H2754.d: or חָרִט; from the same as H2747 (חֶרֶט); properly, cut out (or hollow), i.e. (by implication) a pocket

H2755.d: from the plural of H2716 (חֶרֶא) and the plural of H3123 (יוֹנָה); or perhaps rather the plural of a single word חֲרָאיוֹן, probably a kind of vegetable excrements of doves {or a vegetable}

H2756.d: from H2778 (חָרַף); autumnal; Chariph, the name of two Israelites

H2757.d: or חֲרִץ; from H2782 (חָרַץ); (compare H2742 (חֲרוּץ)) properly, incisure or (passively) incised; hence, a threshing-sledge (with sharp teeth); also a slice (as cut)

H2758.d: from H2790 (חָרַשׁ); ploughing or its season

H2759.d: from H2790 (חָרַשׁ) in the sense of silence; quiet, i.e. sultry (as feminine noun, the sirocco or hot east wind)

H2760.d: a primitive root; to braid (i.e. to entangle or snare) or catch (game) in anet

H2761.d: (Aramaic) a root probably allied to the equivalent of H2787 (חָרַר); to scorch

H2762.d: from H2760 (חָרַךְ); properly, a net, i.e. (by analogy) lattice

H2764.k: (ac-) curse(-d, -d thing), dedicated thing, things which should have been utterly destroyed, (appointed to) utter destruction, devoted (thing), net.

H2765.d: from H2763 (חָרַם); devoted; Chorem, a place in Palestine

H2766.d: from H2763 (חָרַם); snub-nosed; Charim, an Israelite

H2767.d: from H2763 (חָרַם); devoted; Chormah, a place in Palestine

H2768.d: from H2763 (חָרַם); abrupt; Chermon, a mount of Palestine

H2769.d: plural of H2768 (חֶרְמוֹן); Hermons, i.e. its peaks

H2771.d: from H2787 (חָרַר); parched; Charan, the name of a man and also of a place

H2772.d: patrial from H2773 (חֹרֹנַיִם); a Choronite or inhabitant of Choronaim

H2773.d: dual of a derivative from H2356 (חוֹר); double cave-town; Choronajim, a place in Moab

H2774.d: of uncertain derivation; Charnepher, an Israelite

H2775.d: or (with a directive enclitic) חַרְסָה; from an unused root meaning to scrape; also perhaps from the mediating idea of H2777 (חַרְסוּת) the itch; the sun

H2776.d: the same as H2775 (חֶרֶס); shining; Cheres, a mountain in Palestine

H2777.d: from H2775 (חֶרֶס) (apparently in the sense of a red tile used for scraping); a potsherd, i.e. (by implication) a pottery; the name of a gate at Jerusalem

H2778.d: a primitive root; also  denominative (from H2779 (חֹרֶף)) to pull off, i.e. (by implication) to expose (as by stripping); specifically, to betroth (as if a surrender); figuratively, to carp at, i.e. defame; to spend the winter
H2778.k: betroth, blaspheme, defy, jeopard, rail, reproach, upbraid.

H2779.d: from H2778 (חָרַף); properly, the crop gathered, i.e. (by implication) the autumn (and winter) season; figuratively, ripeness of age

H2780.d: from H2778 (חָרַף); reproachful; Chareph, an Israelite

H2781.d: from H2778 (חָרַף); contumely, disgrace, the pudenda

H2782.d: a primitive root; properly, to point sharply, i.e. (literally) to wound; figuratively, to be alert, to decide
H2782.k: bestir self, decide, decree, determine, maim, move.

H2783.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2782 (חָרַץ) in the sense of vigor; the loin (as the seat of strength)

H2784.d: of uncertain derivation; a fetter; figuratively, a pain

H2785.d: from H2782 (חָרַץ); a sour grape (as sharp in taste)

H2786.d: a primitive root; to grate the teeth

H2787.d: a primitive root; to glow, i.e. literally (to melt, burn, dry up) or figuratively (to show or incite passion)

H2789.d: a collateral form mediating between H2775 (חֶרֶס) and H2791 (חֶרֶשׁ); a piece of pottery

H2791.d: from H2790 (חָרַשׁ); magical craft; also silence

H2792.d: the same as H2791 (חֶרֶשׁ) Cheresh, a Levite

H2793.d: from H2790 (חָרַשׁ); a forest (perhaps as furnishing the material for fabric)

H2794.d: active participle of H2790 (חָרַשׁ); a fabricator or mechanic

H2795.d: from H2790 (חָרַשׁ); deaf (whether literally or spiritual)

H2796.d: from H2790 (חָרַשׁ); a fabricator or any material

H2798.d: plural of H2796 (חָרָשׁ); mechanics, the name of a valley in Jerusalem

H2800.d: the same as H2799 (חֲרֹשֶׁת); Charosheth, a place in Palestine

H2802.d: from H2801 (חָרַת) (but equivalent to H2793 (חֹרֶשׁ)); forest; Chereth, a thicket in Palestine

H2803.d: a primitive root; properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute
H2803.k: (make) account (of), conceive, consider, count, cunning (man, work, workman), devise, esteem, find out, forecast, hold, imagine, impute, invent, be like, mean, purpose, reckon(-ing be made), regard, think.

H2805.d: from H2803 (חָשַׁב); a belt or strap (as being interlaced)

H2806.d: from H2803 (חָשַׁב) and H1777 (דִּין); considerate judge; Chasbaddanah, an Israelite

H2807.d: from H2803 (חָשַׁב); estimation; Cashubah, an Israelite

H2808.d: from H2803 (חָשַׁב); properly, contrivance; by implication, intelligence

H2809.d: the same as H2808 (חֶשְׁבּוֹן); Cheshbon, a place East of the Jordan

H2810.d: from H2803 (חָשַׁב); a contrivance, i.e. actual (a warlike machine) or mental (a machination)

H2811.d: or חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ; from H2803 (חָשַׁב) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has regarded; Chashabjah, the name of nine Israelites

H2812.d: feminine of H2808 (חֶשְׁבּוֹן); inventiveness; Chashnah, an Israelite

H2813.d: from H2808 (חֶשְׁבּוֹן) and H3050 (יָהּ); thought of Jah; Chashabnejah, the name of two Israelites

H2814.d: a primitive root; to hush or keep quiet
H2814.k: hold peace, keep silence, be silent, (be) still.

H2815.d: from H2803 (חָשַׁב); intelligent; Chashshub, the name of two or three Israelites

H2816.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2821 (חָשַׁךְ); the dark

H2817.d: or חֲשֻׂפָא; from H2834 (חָשַׂף); nakedness; Chasupha, one of the Nethinim

H2818.d: (Aramaic) a collateral root to one corresponding to H2363 (חוּשׁ) in the sense of readiness; to be necessary (from the idea of convenience) or (transitively) to need

H2819.d: from a root corresponding to H2818 (חֲשַׁח); necessity

H2820.d: a primitive root; also interchangeable  with H2821 (חָשַׁךְ) to restrain or (reflex.) refrain; by implication, to refuse, spare, preserve; to observe

H2821.d: a primitive root; to be dark (as withholding light); transitively, to darken
H2821.k: be black, be (make) dark, darken, cause darkness, be dim, hide.

H2822.d: from H2821 (חָשַׁךְ); the dark; hence (literally) darkness; figuratively, misery, destruction, death, ignorance, sorrow, wickedness

H2825.d: or חֲשֵׁיכָהxlit chăshêkâh corrected to chăshêykâh; from H2821 (חָשַׁךְ); darkness; figuratively, misery

H2826.d: a primitive root; to make (intrans. be) unsteady, i.e. weak

H2827.d: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to H2826 (חָשַׁל); to weaken, i.e. crush

H2828.d: from the same as H2831 (חַשְׁמַן); enriched; Chashum, the name of two or three Israelites

H2829.d: the same as H2831 (חַשְׁמַן); opulent; Cheshmon, a place in Palestine

H2830.d: of uncertain derivation; probably bronze or polished spectrum metal

H2831.d: from an unused root (probably meaning firm or capacious in resources); apparently wealthy

H2832.d: feminine of H2831 (חַשְׁמַן); fertile; Chasmonah, a place in the Desert

H2833.d: from an unused root probably meaning to contain or sparkle; perhaps a pocket (as holding the Urim and Thummim), or rich (as containing gems), used only of the gorget of the highpriest

H2834.d: a primitive root; to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked (for exertion or in disgrace), to drain away or bail up (a liquid)
H2834.k: make bare, clean, discover, draw out, take, uncover.

H2835.d: from H2834 (חָשַׂף); properly, drawn off, i.e. separated; hence, a small company (as divided from the rest)

H2836.d: a primitive root; also interchangeable for H2820 (חָשַׂךְ) to cling, i.e. join, (figuratively) to love, delight in; elliptically; to deliver
H2836.k: have a delight, (have a) desire, fillet, long, set (in) love.

H2838.d: or חָשׁוּק; past participle of H2836 (חָשַׁק); attached, i.e. a fence-rail or rod connecting the posts or pillars

H2839.d: from H2836 (חָשַׁק); conjoined, i.e. a wheel-spoke or rod connecting the hub with the rim

H2840.d: from an unused root meaning to bind together; combined, i.e. the nave or hub of awheel (as holding the spokes together)

H2841.d: from the same as H2840 (חִשֻּׁר); properly, a combination or gathering, i.e. of watery clouds

H2842.d: by variation for H7179 (קַשׁ); dry grass

H2843.d: patronymically from H2364 (חוּשָׁה); a Chushathite or descendant of Chushah

H2844.d: from H2865 (חָתַת); concretely, crushed; also afraid; abstractly, terror

H2845.d: from H2865 (חָתַת); terror; Cheth, an aboriginal Canaanite

H2846.d: a primitive root; to lay hold of; especially to pick up fire

H2848.d: from H2853 (חָתַל); swathed, i.e. a bandage

H2850.d: patronymically from H2845 (חֵת); a Chittite, or descendant of Cheth

H2852.d: a primitive root; properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) to decree

H2855.d: from H2853 (חָתַל); enswathed; Chethlon, a place in Palestine

H2856.d: a primitive root; to close up; especially to seal
H2856.k: make an end, mark, seal (up), stop.

H2857.d: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to H2856 (חָתַם); to seal

H2858.d: feminine active participle of H2856 (חָתַם); a seal

H2859.d: a primitive root; to give (a daughter) away in marriage; hence (generally) to contract affinity by marriage
H2859.k: join in affinity, father in law, make marriages, mother in law, son in law.

H2860.d: from H2859 (חָתַן); a relative by marriage (especially through the bride); figuratively, a circumcised child (as a species of religious espousal)

H2863.d: from H2862 (חָתַף); properly, rapine; figuratively, robbery

H2864.d: a primitive root; to force a passage, as by burglary; figuratively, with oars

H2865.d: a primitive root; properly, to prostrate; hence, to break down, either (literally) by violence, or (figuratively) by confusion and fear
H2865.k: abolish, affright, be (make) afraid, amaze, beat down, discourage, (cause to) dismay, go down, scare, terrify.

H2867.d: the same as H2866 (חֲתַת); Chathath, an Israelite

H2870.d: from H2895 (טוֹב) and H410 (אֵל); pleasing (to) God; Tabeel, the name of a Syrian and of a Persian

H2871.d: passive participle of H2881 (טָבַל); properly, dyed, i.e. a turban (probably as of colored stuff)

H2872.d: from an unused root meaning to pile up; properly, accumulated; i.e. (by implication) a summit

H2873.d: a primitive root; to slaughter (animals or men)

H2874.d: from H2873 (טָבַח); properly, something slaughtered; hence, a beast (or meat, as butchered); abstractly butchery (or concretely, a place of slaughter)

H2875.d: the same as H2874 (טֶבַח); massacre; Tebach, the name of a Mesopotamian and of an Israelite

H2876.d: from H2873 (טָבַח); properly, a butcher; hence, a lifeguardsman (because he was acting as an executioner); also a cook (usually slaughtering the animal for food)

H2877.d: (Aramaic) the same as H2876 (טַבָּח); a lifeguardsman

H2878.d: feminine of H2874 (טֶבַח) and meaning the same {properly, something slaughtered; hence, a beast (or meat, as butchered); abstractly butchery (or concretely, a place of slaughter)}

H2879.d: feminine of H2876 (טַבָּח); a female cook

H2880.d: from H2878 (טִבְחָה); slaughter; Tibchath, a place in Syria

H2881.d: a primitive root; to dip, to immerse

H2882.d: from H2881 (טָבַל) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has dipped; Tebaljah, an Israelite

H2884.d: plural of H2885 (טַבַּעַת); rings; Tabbaoth, one of the Nethinim

H2885.d: from H2883 (טָבַע); properly, a seal (as sunk into the wax), i.e. signet (for sealing); hence (generally) a ring of any kind

H2886.d: from H2895 (טוֹב) and H7417 (רִמּוֹן); pleasing (to) Rimmon; Tabrimmon, a Syrian

H2887.d: probably of foreign derivation; Tebeth, the tenth Hebrew month

H2888.d: of uncertain derivation; Tabbath, a place East of the Jordan

H2889.d: or טָהֹר; from H2891 (טָהֵר); pure (in a physical, chemical, ceremonial or moral sense)

H2891.d: a primitive root; properly, to be bright; i.e. (by implication) to be pure (physical sound, clear, unadulterated; Levitically, uncontaminated; morally, innocent or holy)
H2891.k: be (make, make self, pronounce) clean, cleanse (self), purge, purify(-ier, self).

H2892.d: from H2891 (טָהֵר); literally brightness; ceremonially purification

H2893.d: feminine of H2892 (טֹהַר); ceremonial purification; moral purity

H2894.d: a primitive root; to sweep away
