H3448.d: by Aramaic אִישַׁי; from the same as H3426 (יֵשׁ); extant; Jishai, David's father

H3449.d: or יִשִּׁיָּהוּ; from H5383 (נָשָׁה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will lend; Jishshijah, the name of five Israelites

H3450.d: from H7760 (שׂוּם) and H410 (אֵל); God will place; Jesimael, an Israelite

H3454.d: from H3453 (יָשִׁישׁ); aged; Jeshishai, an Israelite

H3455.d: a primitive root; to place; intransitively, to be placed

H3456.d: a primitive root; to lie waste

H3457.d: from H3456 (יָשַׁם); desolate; Jishma, an Israelite

H3458.d: from H8085 (שָׁמַע) and H410 (אֵל); God will hear; Jishmael, the name of Abraham's oldest son, and of five Israelites

H3459.d: patronymically from H3458 (יִשְׁמָעֵאל); a Jishmaelite or descendant of Jishmael

H3460.d: or יִשְׁמַעְיָהוּlemma יְשְׁמַעְיָהוּ first vowel, corrected to יִשְׁמַעְיָהוּ; from H8085 (שָׁמַע) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will hear; Jishmajah, the name of two Israelites

H3461.d: from H8104 (שָׁמַר); preservative; Jishmerai, an Israelite

H3462.d: a primitive root; properly, to be slack or languid, i.e. (by implication) sleep (figuratively, to die); also to grow old, stale or inveterate

H3464.d: the same as H3463 (יָשֵׁן); Jashen, an Israelite

H3466.d: feminine of H3465 (יָשָׁן); Jeshanah, a place in Palestine

H3467.d: a primitive root; properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor
H3467.k: [idiom] at all, avenging, defend, deliver(-er), help, preserve, rescue, be safe, bring (having) salvation, save(-iour), get victory.

H3468.d: or יֵשַׁע; from H3467 (יָשַׁע); liberty, deliverance, prosperity

H3469.d: from H3467 (יָשַׁע); saving; Jishi, the name of four Israelites

H3470.d: or יְשַׁעְיָהוּ; from H3467 (יָשַׁע) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has saved; Jeshajah, the name of seven Israelites

H3471.d: from an unused root meaning to polish; a gem supposed to be jasper (from the resemblance in name)

H3472.d: perhaps from H8192 (שָׁפָה); he will scratch; Jishpah, an Israelite

H3473.d: probably from the same as H8227 (שָׁפָן); he will hide; Jishpan, an Israelite

H3474.d: a primitive root; to be straight or even; figuratively, to be (causatively, to make) right, pleasant, prosperous
H3474.k: direct, fit, seem good (meet), [phrase] please (will), be (esteem, go) right (on), bring (look, make, take the) straight (way), be upright(-ly).

H3475.d: from H3474 (יָשַׁר); the right; Jesher, an Israelite

H3477.k: convenient, equity, Jasher, just, meet(-est), [phrase] pleased well right(-eous), straight, (most) upright(-ly, -ness).

H3478.d: from H8280 (שָׂרָה) and H410 (אֵל); he will rule as God; Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity

H3479.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3478 (יִשְׂרָאֵל) {Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity}

H3480.d: by variation from H3477 (יָשָׁר) and H410 (אֵל) with directive enclitic; right towards God; Jesarelah, an Israelite

H3481.d: patronymically from H3478 (יִשְׂרָאֵל); a Jisreelite or descendant of Jisrael

H3482.d: feminine of H3481 (יִשְׂרְאֵלִי); a Jisreelitess or female descendant of Jisrael

H3484.d: from H3474 (יָשַׁר); upright; Jeshurun, a symbolic name for Israel

H3485.d: (strictly yis-saws-kawr'); from H5375 (נָשָׂא) and H7939 (שָׂכָר); he will bring a reward; Jissaskar, a son of Jacob

H3486.d: from an unused root meaning to blanch; gray-haired, i.e. an aged man

H3487.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H853 (אֵת); a sign of the object of a verb

H3488.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3427 (יָשַׁב); to sit or dwell

H3489.d: from an unused root meaning to pin through or fast; a peg

H3490.d: from an unused root meaning to be lonely; a bereaved person

H3491.d: passive participle of H3498 (יָתַר); properly, what is left, i.e. (by implication) a gleaning

H3492.d: from H3498 (יָתַר); redundant; Jattir, a place in Palestine

H3493.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3492 (יַתִּיר); preeminent; as an adverb, very

H3494.d: probably from H8518 (תָּלָה); it will hang, i.e. be high; Jithlah, a place in Palestine

H3495.d: from the same as H3490 (יָתוֹם); orphanage; Jithmah, an Israelite

H3496.d: from an unused root meaning to endure, and H410 (אֵל); continued of God; Jathniel, an Israelite

H3497.d: from the same as H8577 (תַּנִּין); extensive; Jithnan, a place in Palestine

H3498.d: a primitive root; to jut over or exceed; by implication, to excel; (intransitively) to remain or be left; causatively, to leave, cause to abound, preserve
H3498.k: excel, leave (a remnant), left behind, too much, make plenteous, preserve, (be, let) remain(-der, -ing, -nant), reserve, residue, rest.

H3499.d: from H3498 (יָתַר); properly, an overhanging, i.e. (by implication) an excess, superiority, remainder; also a small rope (as hanging free)
H3499.k: [phrase] abundant, cord, exceeding, excellancy(-ent), what they leave, that hath left, plentifully, remnant, residue, rest, string, with.

H3500.d: the same as H3499 (יֶתֶר); Jether, the name of five or six Israelites and of one Midianite

H3501.d: by variation for H3502 (יִתְרָה); Jithra, an Israelite (or Ishmaelite)

H3502.d: feminine of H3499 (יֶתֶר); properly, excellence, i.e. (by implication) wealth

H3503.d: from H3499 (יֶתֶר) with pron. suffix; his excellence; Jethro, Moses' father-in-law

H3505.d: patronymically from H3500 (יֶתֶר); a Jithrite or descendant of Jether

H3506.d: from H3498 (יָתַר); excellent; Jithran, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite

H3507.d: from H3499 (יֶתֶר) and H5971 (עַם); excellence of people; Jithream, a son of David

H3508.d: feminine active participle of H3498 (יָתַר); the lobe or flap of the liver (as if redundant or outhanging)

H3509.d: of uncertain derivation; Jetheth, an Edomite

H3510.d: a primitive root; properly, to feel pain; by implication, to grieve; figuratively, to spoil
H3510.k: grieving, mar, have pain, make sad (sore), (be) sorrowful.

H3511.d: from H3510 (כָּאַב); suffering (physical or mental), adversity

H3512.d: a primitive root; to despond; causatively, to deject

H3513.d: or כָּבֵד; a primitive root; to be heavy, i.e. in a bad sense (burdensome, severe, dull) or in a good sense (numerous, rich, honorable; causatively, to make weighty (in the same two senses)
H3513.k: abounding with, more grievously afflict, boast, be chargeable, [idiom] be dim, glorify, be (make) glorious (things), glory, (very) great, be grievous, harden, be (make) heavy, be heavier, lay heavily, (bring to, come to, do, get, be had in) honour (self), (be) honourable (man), lade, [idiom] more be laid, make self many, nobles, prevail, promote (to honour), be rich, be (go) sore, stop.

H3515.d: from H3513 (כָּבַד); heavy; figuratively in a good sense (numerous) or in a bad sense (severe, difficult, stupid)
H3515.k: (so) great, grievous, hard(-ened), (too) heavy(-ier), laden, much, slow, sore, thick.

H3516.d: the same as H3515 (כָּבֵד); the liver (as the heaviest of the viscera)

H3518.d: a primitive root; to expire or (causatively) to extinguish (fire, light, anger)

H3519.d: rarely כָּבֹד; from H3513 (כָּבַד); properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness

H3520.d: irregular feminine passive participle of H3513 (כָּבַד); weightiness, i.e. magnificence, wealth

H3521.d: from the same as H3525 (כֶּבֶל) in the sense of limitation; sterile; Cabul, the name of two places in Palestine

H3522.d: from an unused root meaning to heap up; hilly; Cabon, a place in Palestine

H3523.d: from H3527 (כָּבַר) in the original sense of plaiting; a matrass (of intertwined materials)

H3524.d: from H3527 (כָּבַר); vast, whether in extent (figuratively, of power, mighty; of time, aged), or in number, many
H3524.k: [phrase] feeble, mighty, most, much, strong, valiant.

H3525.d: from an unused root meaning to twine or braid together; a fetter

H3526.d: a primitive root; to trample; hence, to wash (properly, by stamping with the feet), whether literal (including the fulling process) or figurative

H3527.d: a primitive root; properly, to plait together, i.e. (figuratively) to augment (especially in number or quantity, to accumulate)

H3528.d: from H3527 (כָּבַר); properly, extent of time, i.e. a great while; hence, long ago, formerly, hitherto

H3529.d: the same as H3528 (כְּבָר); length; Kebar, a river of Mesopotamia

H3530.d: feminine of H3528 (כְּבָר); properly, length, i.e. a measure (of uncertain dimension)

H3531.d: from H3527 (כָּבַר) in its original sense; a sieve (as netted)

H3532.d: from an unused root meaning to dominate; a ram (just old enough to butt)

H3533.d: a primitive root; to tread down; hence, negatively, to disregard; positively, to conquer, subjugate, violate
H3533.k: bring into bondage, force, keep under, subdue, bring into subjection.

H3534.d: from H3533 (כָּבַשׁ); a footstool (as trodden upon)

H3535.d: or כַּבְשָׂה; feminine of H3532 (כֶּבֶשׂ); a ewe

H3536.d: from H3533 (כָּבַשׁ); a smelting furnace (as reducing metals)

H3537.d: from an unused root meaning to deepen; properly, a pail; but generally of earthenware; a jar for domestic purposes

H3538.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H3576 (כָּזַב); false

H3539.d: from the same as H3537 (כַּד) in the sense of striking fire from a metal forged; a sparkling gem, probably the ruby

H3540.d: of foreign origin; Kedorlaomer, an early Persian king

H3541.d: from the prefix k and H1931 (הוּא); properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now
H3541.k: also, here, + hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way), + mean while, yonder.

H3542.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3541 (כֹּה) {properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now}

H3543.d: a primitive root; to be weak, i.e. (figuratively) to despond (causatively, rebuke), or (of light, the eye) to grow dull
H3543.k: darken, be dim, fail, faint, restrain, [idiom] utterly.

H3544.k: somewhat dark, darkish, wax dim, heaviness, smoking.

H3545.d: feminine of H3544 (כֵּהֶה); properly, a weakening; figuratively, alleviation, i.e. cure

H3546.d: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to and H3557 (כּוּל); to be able

H3547.d: a primitive root, apparently meaning to mediate in religious services; but used only as denominative from H3548 (כֹּהֵן); to officiate as a priest; figuratively, to put on regalia
H3547.k: deck, be (do the office of a, execute the, minister in the) priest('s office).

H3548.d: active participle of H3547 (כָּהַן); literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
H3548.k: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.

H3549.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3548 (כֹּהֵן) {one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)}

H3551.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H3854 (לַהַג) in the sense of piercing; a window (as a perforation)

H3552.d: of foreign derivation; Kub, a country near Egypt

H3553.d: from an unused root meaning to be high or rounded; a helmet (as arched)

H3554.d: a primitive root; properly, to prick or penetrate; hence, to blister (as smarting or eating into)

H3556.d: probably from the same as H3522 (כַּבּוֹן) (in the sense of rolling) or H3554 (כָּוָה) (in the sense of blazing); a star (as round or as shining); figuratively, a prince

H3557.d: a primitive root; properly, to keep in; hence, to measure; figuratively, to maintain (in various senses)
H3557.k: (be able to, can) abide, bear, comprehend, contain, feed, forbearing, guide, hold(-ing in), nourish(-er), be present, make provision, receive, sustain, provide sustenance (victuals).

H3558.d: from an unused root meaning to store away; a jewel (probably gold beads)

H3559.d: a primitive root; properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
H3559.k: certain(-ty), confirm, direct, faithfulness, fashion, fasten, firm, be fitted, be fixed, frame, be meet, ordain, order, perfect, (make) preparation, prepare (self), provide, make provision, (be, make) ready, right, set (aright, fast, forth), be stable, (e-) stablish, stand, tarry, [idiom] very deed.

H3560.d: probably from H3559 (כּוּן); established; Kun, a place in Syria

H3561.d: from H3559 (כּוּן); something prepared, i.e. a sacrificial wafer

H3562.d: from H3559 (כּוּן) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has sustained; Conanjah, the name of two Israelites

H3563.d: from an unused root meaning to hold together; a cup (as a container), often figuratively, a lot (as if a potion); also some unclean bird, probably an owl (perhaps from the cup-like cavity of its eye)

H3564.d: from an unused root meaning properly, to dig through; a pot or furnace (as if excavated)

H3565.d: from H3564 (כּוּר) and H6227 (עָשָׁן); furnace of smoke; Cor-Ashan, a place in Palestine

H3566.d: or (Ezra 1:1 (last time),2) כֹּרֶשׁ; from the Persians; Koresh (or Cyrus), the Persian king

H3567.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3566 (כּוֹרֶשׁ) {Koresh (or Cyrus), the Persian king}

H3568.d: probably of foreign origin; Cush (or Ethiopia), the name of a son of Ham, and of his territory; also of an Israelite

H3569.d: patronymically from H3568 (כּוּשׁ); a Cushite, or descendant of Cush

H3570.d: the same as H3569 (כּוּשִׁי); Cushi, the name of two Israelites

H3571.d: feminine of H3569 (כּוּשִׁי); a Cushite woman

H3572.d: perhaps from H3568 (כּוּשׁ); Cushan, a region of Arabia

H3573.d: apparently from H3572 (כּוּשָׁן) and the dual of H7564 (רִשְׁעָה); Cushan of double wickedness; Cushan-Rishathajim, a Mesopotamian king

H3574.d: from H3787 (כָּשֵׁר); prosperity; in plural freedom

H3575.d: or (feminine) כּוּתָה; of foreign origin; Cuth or Cuthah, a province of Assyria

H3576.d: a primitive root; to lie (i.e. deceive), literally or figuratively
H3576.k: fail, (be found a, make a) liar, lie, lying, be in vain.

H3577.d: from H3576 (כָּזַב); falsehood; literally (untruth) or figuratively (idol)
H3577.k: deceitful, false, leasing, + liar, lie, lying.

H3578.d: from H3576 (כָּזַב); fallacious; Cozeba, a place in Palestine

H3579.d: from H3576 (כָּזַב); false; Cozbi, a Midianitess

H3580.d: from H3576 (כָּזַב); falsified; Kezib, a place in Palestine

H3581.d: or (Daniel 11:6) כּוֹחַ; from an unused root meaning to be firm; vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard
H3581.k: ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power(-ful), strength, substance, wealth.

H3582.d: a primitive root; to secrete, by act or word; hence (intensively) to destroy

H3583.d: a primitive root; to paint (with stibium)

H3584.d: a primitive root; to be untrue, in word (to lie, feign, disown) or deed (to disappoint, fail, cringe)
H3584.k: deceive, deny, dissemble, fail, deal falsely, be found liars, (be-) lie, lying, submit selves.

H3585.d: from H3584 (כָּחַשׁ); literally a failure of flesh, i.e. emaciation; figuratively, hypocrisy

H3587.d: from H3554 (כָּוָה); a brand or scar

H3588.d: a primitive particle (the full form of the prepositional prefix) indicating causal relations of all kinds, antecedent or consequent; (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H3588.k: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.

H3589.d: from a primitive root meaning to strike; a crushing; figuratively, calamity

H3590.d: from the same as H3589 (כִּיד) (compare H3539 (כַּדְכֹּד)); properly, something struck off, i.e. a spark (as struck)

H3591.d: from the same as H3589 (כִּיד); (perhaps smaller than H2595 (חֲנִית)lemma חֲניִת second vowel, corrected to חֲנִית) properly, something to strike with, i.e. a dart

H3592.d: the same as H3591 (כִּידוֹן); Kidon, a place in Palestine

H3594.d: from H3559 (כּוּן); properly, a statue, i.e. idol; but used (by euphemism) forsome heathen deity (perhaps corresponding to Priapus or Baal-peor)

H3595.d: or כִּיֹּר; from the same as H3564 (כּוּר); properly, something round (as excavated or bored), i.e. a chafing-dish forcoals or a caldron forcooking; hence (from similarity of form) a washbowl; also (for the same reason) a pulpit or platform

H3596.d: or כֵּלַי; from H3557 (כּוּל) in the sense of withholding; niggardly

H3597.d: from an unused root meaning to clap or strike with noise; a club or sledge-hammer

H3598.d: from the same as H3558 (כּוּמָז); a cluster of stars, i.e. the Pleiades

H3599.d: a form for H3563 (כּוֹס); a cup; also a bag formoney or weights

H3600.d: a form for H3564 (כּוּר) (only in the dual); a cooking range (consisting of two parallel stones, across which the boiler is set)

H3601.d: from H3787 (כָּשֵׁר); compare H6418 (פֶּלֶךְ) literally a director, i.e. the spindle or shank of adistaff, by which it is twirled

H3602.d: from H3541 (כֹּה); just so, referring to the previous or following context
H3602.k: after that (this) manner, this matter, (even) so, in such a case, thus.

H3603.d: from H3769 (כָּרַר); a circle, i.e. (by implication) a circumjacent tract or region, especially the Ghor or valley of the Jordan; also a (round) loaf; also a talent (or large [round] coin)

H3605.d: or (Jeremiah 33:8) כּוֹל; from H3634 (כָּלַל); properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H3605.k: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

H3606.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3605 (כֹּל) {properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)}
H3606.k: all, any, + (forasmuch) as, + be-(for this) cause, every, + no (manner, -ne), + there (where) -fore, + though, what (where, who) -soever, (the) whole.

H3607.d: a primitive root; to restrict, by act (hold back or in) or word (prohibit)
H3607.k: finish, forbid, keep (back), refrain, restrain, retain, shut up, be stayed, withhold.

H3609.d: apparently from H3607 (כָּלָא) and H1 (אָב); restraint of (his) father; Kilab, an Israelite

H3610.d: dual of H3608 (כֶּלֶא) in the original sense of separation; two heterogeneities

H3611.d: from an unused root means. to yelp, or else to attack; a dog; hence (by euphemism) a male prostitute

H3612.d: perhaps a form of H3611 (כֶּלֶב), or else from the same root in the sense of forcible; Caleb, the name of three Israelites

H3613.d: from H3612 (כָּלֵב) and H672 (אֶפְרָת); Caleb-Ephrathah, a place in Egypt (if the text is correct)

H3614.d: probably by erroneous transcription for כָּלֵבִי; patronymically from H3612 (כָּלֵב); a Calebite or descendant of Caleb

H3615.d: a primitive root; to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume)
H3615.k: accomplish, cease, consume (away), determine, destroy (utterly), be (when... were) done, (be an) end (of), expire, (cause to) fail, faint, finish, fulfil, [idiom] fully, [idiom] have, leave (off), long, bring to pass, wholly reap, make clean riddance, spend, quite take away, waste.

H3617.d: from H3615 (כָּלָה); a completion; adverb, completely; also destruction
H3617.k: altogether, (be, utterly) consume(-d), consummation(-ption), was determined, (full, utter) end, riddance.

H3618.d: from H3634 (כָּלַל); a bride (as if perfect); hence, a son's wife

H3619.d: from the same as H3611 (כֶּלֶב); a bird-trap (as furnished with a clap-stick or treadle to spring it); hence, a basket (as resembling a wicker cage)

H3620.d: the same as H3619 (כְּלוּב)xlit kᵉlûb corrected to kᵉlûwb; Kelub, the name of two Israelites

H3621.d: a form of H3612 (כָּלֵב); Kelubai, an Israelite

H3622.d: from H3615 (כָּלָה); completed; Keluhai, an Israelite

H3623.d: denominative passive participle from H3618 (כַּלָּה)lemma כַּלָה missing dagesh, corrected to כַּלָּה; bridehood (only in the plural)

H3624.d: from an unused root meaning to be complete; maturity

H3625.d: the same as H3624 (כֶּלַח); Kelach, a place in Assyria

H3626.d: from H3605 (כֹּל) and H2374 (חֹזֶה); every seer; Col-Chozeh, an Israelite

H3627.d: from H3615 (כָּלָה); something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon)

H3777.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Kesed, a relative of Abraham

H5065.k: distress, driver, exact(-or), oppress(-or), [idiom] raiser of taxes, taskmaster.

H5066.d: a primitive root; to be or come (causatively, bring) near (for any purpose); euphemistically, to lie with a woman; as an enemy, to attack; religious to worship; causatively, to present; figuratively, to adduce an argument; by reversal, to stand back
H5066.k: (make to) approach (nigh), bring (forth, hither, near), (cause to) come (hither, near, nigh), give place, go hard (up), (be, draw, go) near (nigh), offer, overtake, present, put, stand.

H5067.d: from H5110 (נוּד) in the sense of piling up; a mound, i.e. wave

H5068.d: a primitive root; to impel; hence, to volunteer (as a soldier), to present spontaneously
H5068.k: offer freely, be (give, make, offer self) willing(-ly).

H5069.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5068 (נָדַב); be (or give) liberal(-ly)

H5070.d: from H5068 (נָדַב); liberal; Nadab, the name of four Israelites

H5071.d: from H5068 (נָדַב); properly (abstractly) spontaneity, or (adjectively) spontaneous; also (concretely) a spontaneous or (by inference, in plural) abundant gift
H5071.k: free(-will) offering, freely, plentiful, voluntary(-ily, offering), willing(-ly), offering).

H5072.d: from H5068 (נָדַב) and H3050 (יָהּ); largess of Jah; Nedabjah, an Israelite

H5073.d: (Aramaic) from a root meaning to stick; a layer (of building materials)

H5074.d: a primitive root; properly, to wave to and fro (rarely to flap up and down); figuratively, to rove, flee, or (causatively) to drive away
H5074.k: chase (away), [idiom] could not, depart, flee ([idiom] apace, away), (re-) move, thrust away, wander (abroad, -er, -ing).

H5076.d: passive participle of H5074 (נָדַד); properly, tossed; abstractly, a rolling (on the bed)

H5077.d: or נָדָא; (2 Kings 17:21), a primitive root; properly, to toss; figuratively, to exclude, i.e. banish, postpone, prohibit
H5077.k: cast out, drive, put far away.

H5078.d: from H5077 (נָדָה) in the sense of freely flinging money; a bounty (for prostitution)

H5079.d: from H5074 (נָדַד); properly, rejection; by implication, impurity, especially personal (menstruation) or moral (idolatry, incest)
H5079.k: [idiom] far, filthiness, [idiom] flowers, menstruous (woman), put apart, [idiom] removed (woman), separation, set apart, unclean(-ness, thing, with filthiness).

H5080.d: a primitive root; to push off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.)
H5080.k: banish, bring, cast down (out), chase, compel, draw away, drive (away, out, quite), fetch a stroke, force, go away, outcast, thrust away (out), withdraw.

H5081.d: from H5068 (נָדַב); properly, voluntary, i.e. generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant)

H5082.d: feminine of H5081 (נָדִיב); properly, nobility, i.e. reputation

H5083.d: probably from an unused root meaning to give; a present (for prostitution)

H5084.d: of uncertain derivation; a sheath (of a sword)

H5085.d: (Aramaic) from the same as H5084 (נָדָן); a sheath; figuratively, the body (as the receptacle of the soul)

H5086.d: a primitive root; to shove asunder, i.e. disperse
H5086.k: drive (away, to and fro), thrust down, shaken, tossed to and fro.

H5087.d: a primitive root; to promise (pos., to do or give something to God)

H5088.d: or נֵדֶר; from H5087 (נָדַר); a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised

H5089.d: from an unused root meaning to lament; lamentation

H5090.d: a primitive root; to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead, carry away; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh
H5090.k: acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead (away, forth).

H5091.d: a primitive root; to groan, i.e. bewail; hence (through the idea of crying aloud), to assemble (as if on proclamation)

H5094.d: (Aramaic) or נְהִירוּ; (Aramaic), from the same as H5105 (נְהָרָה); illumination, i.e. (figuratively) wisdom

H5095.d: a primitive root; properly, to run with asparkle, i.e. flow; hence (transitively), to conduct, and (by inference) to protect, sustain

H5096.d: or נַהֲלֹל; the same as H5097 (נַהֲלֹל); Nahalal or Nahalol, a place in Palestine

H5101.d: a primitive root; to bray (as an ass), scream (from hunger)

H5102.d: a primitive root; to sparkle, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; hence (from the sheen of a running stream) to flow, i.e. (figuratively) assemble

H5103.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H5102 (נָהַר); a river, especially the Euphrates

H5104.d: from H5102 (נָהַר); a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity

H5105.d: from H5102 (נָהַר) in its original sense; daylight

H5106.d: a primitive root; to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize
H5106.k: break, disallow, discourage, make of none effect.

H5107.d: a primitive root; to germinate, i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make) flourish; also (of words), to utter

H5108.d: or נֵיב; from H5107 (נוּב); produce, literally or figuratively

H5109.d: from H5108 (נוֹב); fruitful; Nobai, an Israelite

H5110.d: a primitive root; to nod, i.e. waver; figuratively, to wander, flee, disappear; also (from shaking the head in sympathy), to console, deplore, or (from tossing the head in scorn) taunt
H5110.k: bemoan, flee, get, mourn, make to move, take pity, remove, shake, skip for joy, be sorry, vagabond, way, wandering.

H5113.d: the same as H5112 (נוֹד)lemma נוֹדּ extra dagesh, corrected to נוֹד; vagrancy; Nod, the land of Cain

H5114.d: from H5068 (נָדַב); noble; Nodab, an Arab tribe

H5115.d: a primitive root; (compare H5116 (נָוֶה)) to rest (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of beauty ), to celebrate (with praises)
H5115.k: keept at home, prepare an habitation.

H5116.d: or (feminine) נָוָה; from H5115 (נָוָה); (adjectively) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den)
H5116.k: comely, dwelling (place), fold, habitation, pleasant place, sheepcote, stable, tarried.

H5117.d: a primitive root; to rest, i.e. settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, intransitive, transitive and causative (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, withdraw, give comfort, etc.)
H5117.k: cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare H3241 (יָנִים).

H5119.d: feminine of H5118 (נוּחַ); quietude; Nochah, an Israelite

H5121.d: from H5115 (נָוָה); residence; Navith, a place in Palestine

H5122.d: (Aramaic) or נְוָלִי; (Aramaic), from an unused root probably meaning to be foul; a sink

H5123.d: a primitive root; to slumber (from drowsiness)

H5125.d: a primitive root; to resprout, i.e. propagate by shoots; figuratively, to be perpetual

H5126.d: or נוֹן; (1 Chronicles 7:27), from H5125 (נוּן); perpetuity, Nun or Non, the father of Joshua

H5127.d: a primitive root; to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver)
H5127.k: [idiom] abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, [idiom] hide, lift up a standard.

H5128.d: a primitive root; to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined)
H5128.k: continually, fugitive, [idiom] make, to (go) up and down, be gone away, (be) move(-able, -d), be promoted, reel, remove, scatter, set, shake, sift, stagger, to and fro, be vagabond, wag, (make) wander (up and down).

H5129.d: from H3259 (יָעַד) and H3050 (יָהּ); convened of Jah; Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess

H5130.d: a primitive root; to quiver (i.e. vibrate up and down, or rock to and fro); used in a great variety of applications (including sprinkling, beckoning, rubbing, bastinadoing, sawing, waving, etc.)
H5130.k: lift up, move, offer, perfume, send, shake, sift, strike, wave.

H5132.d: a primitive root; properly, to flash; hence, to blossom (from the brilliancy of color); also, to fly away (from the quickness of motion)

H5133.d: or נֹצָה; feminine active participle of H5327 (נָצָה) in the sense of flying; a pinion (or wing feather); often (collectively) plumage

H5135.d: (Aramaic) from an unused root (corresponding to that of H5216 (נִיר)) meaning to shine; fire

H5136.d: a primitive root; to be sick, i.e. (figuratively) distressed

H5137.d: a primitive root; to spirt, i.e. besprinkle (especially in expiation)

H5138.d: from H2102 (זוּד); something boiled, i.e. soup

H5139.d: or נָזִר; from H5144 (נָזַר); separate, i.e. consecrated (as prince, a Nazirite); hence (figuratively from the latter) an unpruned vine (like an unshorn Nazirite)
H5139.k: Nazarite (by a false alliteration with Nazareth), separate(-d), vine undressed.

H5140.d: a primitive root; to drip, or shed by trickling
H5140.k: distil, drop, flood, (cause to) flow(-ing), gush out, melt, pour (down), running water, stream.

H5141.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a nose-ring

H5142.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of H5143 (נֵזֶק); to suffer (causatively, inflict) loss

H5143.d: from an unused root meaning to injure; loss

H5144.d: a primitive root; to hold aloof, i.e. (intransitivey) abstain (from food and drink, from impurity, and even from divine worship (i.e. apostatize)); specifically, to set apart (to sacred purposes), i.e. devote

H5145.d: or נֵזֶר; from H5144 (נָזַר); properly, something set apart, i.e. (abstractly) dedication (of a priet or Nazirite); hence (concretely) unshorn locks; also (by implication) a chaplet (especially of royalty)

H5146.d: the same as H5118 (נוּחַ); rest; Noach, the patriarch of the flood

H5147.d: from H2247 (חָבָה); occult; Nachbi, an Israelite

H5148.d: a primitive root; to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists)
H5148.k: bestow, bring, govern, guide, lead (forth), put, straiten.

H5149.d: from H5162 (נָחַם); comforted; Nechum, an Israelite

H5150.d: or נִחֻם; from H5162 (נָחַם); properly, consoled; abstractly, solace

H5151.d: from H5162 (נָחַם); comfortable; Nachum, an Israelite prophet

H5152.d: from the same as H5170 (נַחַר); snorer; Nochor, the name of the grandfather and a brother of Abraham

H5153.d: apparently passive participle of H5172 (נָחַשׁ) (perhaps in the sense of ringing), i.e. bell-metal; or from the red color of the throat of a serpent (H5175 (נָחָשׁ), as denominative) when hissing); coppery, i.e. (figuratively) hard

H5154.d: or נְחֻשָׁה; feminine of H5153 (נָחוּשׁ); copper

H5155.d: probably denominative from H2485 (חָלִיל); a flute

H5156.d: from the same as H5170 (נַחַר); a nostril

H5157.d: a primitive root; to inherit (as a (figurative) mode of descent), or (generally) to occupy; causatively, to bequeath, or (generally) distribute, instate
H5157.k: divide, have (inheritance), take as a heritage, (cause to, give to, make to) inherit, (distribute for, divide (for, for an, by), give for, have, leave for, take (for)) inheritance, (have in, cause to, be made to) possess(-ion).

H5158.d: or (feminine) נַחְלָה; (Psalm 124:4), or נַחֲלָה; (Ezekiel 47:19; Ezekiel 48:28), from H5157 (נָחַל) in its original sense; a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine)

H5159.d: from H5157 (נָחַל) (in its usual sense); properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion
H5159.k: heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare H5158 (נַחַל).

H5160.d: from H5158 (נַחַל) and H410 (אֵל); valley of God; Nachaliel, a place in the Desert

H5161.d: apparently a patronymic from an unused name (apparently passive participle of H2492 (חָלַם)); dreamed; a Nechelamite, or descendant of Nechlam

H5162.d: a primitive root; properly, to sigh, i.e. breathe strongly; by implication, to be sorry, i.e. (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself)

H5163.d: from H5162 (נָחַם); consolation; Nacham, an Israelite

H5166.d: from H5162 (נָחַם) and H3050 (יָהּ); consolation of Jah; Nechemjah, the name of three Israelites

H5167.d: from H5162 (נָחַם); consolatory; Nachamani, an Israelite

H5169.d: a primitive root; to be urgent

H5170.d: and (feminine) נַחֲרָה; from an unused root meaning to snort or snore; a snorting

H5171.d: or נַחְרַי; from the same as H5170 (נַחַר); snorer; Nacharai or Nachrai, an Israelite

H5172.d: a primitive root; properly, to hiss, i.e. whisper a (magic) spell; generally, to prognosticate
H5172.k: [idiom] certainly, divine, enchanter, (use) [idiom] enchantment, learn by experience, [idiom] indeed, diligently observe.

H5173.d: from H5172 (נָחַשׁ); an incantation or augury

H5175.d: from H5172 (נָחַשׁ); a snake (from its hiss)

H5176.d: the same as H5175 (נָחָשׁ); Nachash, the name of two persons apparently non-Israelite

H5177.d: from H5172 (נָחַשׁ); enchanter; Nachshon, an Israelite

H5178.d: for H5154 (נְחוּשָׁה); copper, hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin, a fetter; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver)
H5178.k: brasen, brass, chain, copper, fetter (of brass), filthiness, steel.

H5179.d: from H5178 (נְחֹשֶׁת); copper; Nechushta, an Israelitess

H5180.d: from H5178 (נְחֹשֶׁת); something made of copper, i.e. the copper serpent of the Desert

H5181.d: a primitive root; to sink, i.e. descend; causatively, to press or lead down
H5181.k: be broken, (cause to) come down, enter, go down, press sore, settle, stick fast.

H5182.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5181 (נָחַת); to descend; causatively, to bring away, deposit, depose
H5182.k: carry, come down, depose, lay up, place.

H5183.d: from H5182 (נְחַת); also (intransitively; perhaps from H5117 (נוּחַ)) a descent, i.e. imposition, unfavorable (punishment) or favorable (food); restfulness
H5183.k: lighting down, quiet(-ness), to rest, be set on.

H5184.d: the same as H5183 (נַחַת); quiet; Nachath, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites

H5186.d: a primitive root; to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application
H5186.k: [phrase] afternoon, apply, bow (down, -ing), carry aside, decline, deliver, extend, go down, be gone, incline, intend, lay, let down, offer, outstretched, overthrown, pervert, pitch, prolong, put away, shew, spread (out), stretch (forth, out), take (aside), turn (aside, away), wrest, cause to yield.

H5188.d: from H5197 (נָטַף); a pendant for the ears (especially of pearls)

H5189.d: from H5203 (נָטַשׁ); a tendril (as an offshoot)

H5190.d: a primitive root; to lift; by implication, to impose

H5193.d: a primitive root; properly, to strike in, i.e. fix; specifically, to plant (literally or figuratively)

H5194.d: from H5193 (נָטַע); a plant; collectively, a plantation; abstractly, a planting

H5196.d: plural of H5194 (נֶטַע); Netaim, a place in Palestine

H5197.d: a primitive root; to ooze, i.e. distil gradually; by implication, to fall in drops; figuratively, to speak by inspiration

H5198.d: from H5197 (נָטַף); a drop; specifically, an aromatic gum (probably stacte)

H5199.d: from H5197 (נָטַף); distillation; Netophah, a place in Palestine

H5200.d: patronymic from H5199 (נְטֹפָה); a Netophathite, or inhabitant of Netophah

H5201.d: a primitive root; to guard; figuratively, to cherish (anger)

H5203.d: a primitive root; properly, to pound, i.e. smite; by implication (as if beating out, and thus expanding) to disperse; also, to thrust off, down, out or upon (inclusively, reject, let alone, permit, remit, etc.)
H5203.k: cast off, drawn, let fall, forsake, join (battle), leave (off), lie still, loose, spread (self) abroad, stretch out, suffer.

H5204.d: a doubtful word; apparently from H5091 (נָהָה); lamentation

H5205.d: from H5110 (נוּד); motion (of the lips in speech)

H5206.d: feminine of H5205 (נִיד); removal, i.e. exile

H5207.d: or נִיחֹחַ; from H5117 (נוּחַ); properly, restful, i.e. pleasant; abstractly, delight

H5208.d: (Aramaic) or נִיחֹחַ; (shorter) (Aramaic), corresponding to H5207 (נִיחוֹחַ); pleasure

H5210.d: of foreign origin; Nineveh, the capital of Assyria

H5212.d: probably of foreign origin; Nisan, the first month of the Jewish sacred year

H5214.d: a root probably identical with that of H5216 (נִיר), through the idea of the gleam of a fresh furrow; to till the soil

H5215.d: or נִר; from H5214 (נִיר); properly, plowing, i.e. (concretely) freshly plowed land

H5216.d: or נִר; also נֵיר; or נֵר; or (feminine) נֵרָה; from a primitive root (see H5214 (נִיר); H5135 (נוּר)) properly, meaning to glisten; a lamp (i.e. the burner) or light (literally or figuratively)

H5217.d: a primitive root; to smite, i.e. drive away

H5218.d: or נָכָא; from H5217 (נָכָא); smitten, i.e. (figuratively) afflicted

H5219.d: from H5218 (נָכֵא); properly, a smiting, i.e. (concretely) an aromatic gum (perhaps styrax) (as powdered)

H5220.d: from an unused root meaning to propagate; offspring

H5221.d: a primitive root; to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
H5221.k: beat, cast forth, clap, give (wounds), [idiom] go forward, [idiom] indeed, kill, make (slaughter), murderer, punish, slaughter, slay(-er, -ing), smite(-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, [idiom] surely, wound.

H5222.d: from H5221 (נָכָה); a smiter, i.e. (figuratively) traducer

H5224.d: probably of Egyptian origin; Neko, an Egyptian king

H5225.d: from H3559 (כּוּן); prepared; Nakon, probably an Israelite

H5226.d: from an unused root meaning to be straightforward; properly, the fore part; used adverbially, opposite

H5227.d: from the same as H5226 (נֵכַח); properly, the front part; used adverbially (especially with preposition), opposite, in front of, forward, in behalf of

H5228.d: from the same as H5226 (נֵכַח); straightforward, i.e. (figuratively), equitable, correct, or (abstractly), integrity

H5229.d: feminine of H5228 (נָכֹחַ); properly, straightforwardness, i.e. (figuratively) integrity, or (concretely) a truth

H5230.d: a primitive root; to defraud, i.e. act treacherously

H5233.d: from an unused root meaning to accumulate; treasure

H5234.d: a primitive root; properly, to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at; hence (with recognition implied), to acknowledge, be acquainted with, care for, respect, revere, or (with suspicion implied), to disregard, ignore, be strange toward, reject, resign, dissimulate (as if ignorant or disowning)
H5234.k: acknowledge, [idiom] could, deliver, discern, dissemble, estrange, feign self to be another, know, take knowledge (notice), perceive, regard, (have) respect, behave (make) self strange(-ly).

H5235.d: or נֹכֶר; from H5234 (נָכַר); something strange, i.e. unexpected calamity

H5236.d: ' from H5234 (נָכַר); foreign, or (concretely) a foreigner, or (abstractly) heathendom

H5237.d: from H5235 (נֶכֶר) (second form); strange, in a variety of degrees and applications (foreign, non-relative, adulterous, different, wonderful)

H5238.d: probably for H5219 (נְכֹאת); spicery, i.e. (generally) valuables

H5239.d: apparently a primitive root; to complete

H5241.d: apparently for H3223 (יְמוּאֵל); Nemuel, the name of two Israelites

H5242.d: from H5241 (נְמוּאֵל); a Nemuelite, or descendant of Nemuel

H5243.d: a primitive root; to become clipped or (specifically) circumcised

H5244.d: feminine from H5243 (נָמַל); an ant (probably from its almost bisected form)

H5245.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5246 (נָמֵר) {a leopard (from its stripes)}

H5246.d: from an unused root meaning properly, to filtrate, i.e. be limpid (comp H5247 (נִמְרָה) and H5249 (נִמְרִים)); and thus to spot or stain as if by dripping; a leopard (from its stripes)

H5247.d: from the same as H5246 (נָמֵר); clear water; Nimrah, a place East of the Jordan
H5247.k: Nimrah. See also H1039 (בֵּית נִמְרָה), H5249 (נִמְרִים).

H5248.d: or נִמְרֹד; probably of foreign origin; Nimrod, a son of Cush

H5249.d: plural of a masculine corresponding to H5247 (נִמְרָה); clear waters; Nimrim, a place East of the Jordan

H5250.d: probably from H4871 (מָשָׁה); extricated; Nimshi, the (grand-) father of Jehu

H5251.d: from H5264 (נָסַס); a flag; also a sail; by implication, a flagstaff; generally a signal; figuratively, a token

H5252.d: feminine participle passive of H5437 (סָבַב); properly, an environment, i.e. circumstance or turn of affairs

H5253.k: departing away, remove, take (hold), turn away.

H5254.d: a primitive root; to test; by implication, to attempt

H5255.d: a primitive root; to tear away

H5257.d: from H5258 (נָסַךְ); properly, something poured out, i.e. a libation; also a molten image; by implication, a prince (as anointed)

H5258.d: a primitive root; to pour out, especially a libation, or to cast (metal); by analogy, to anoint aking
H5258.k: cover, melt, offer, (cause to) pour (out), set (up).

H5259.d: a primitive root (probably identical with H5258 (נָסַךְ) through the idea of fusion); to interweave, i.e. (figuratively) to overspread

H5260.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5258 (נָסַךְ); to pour out a libation

H5262.d: or נֵסֶךְ; from H5258 (נָסַךְ); a libation; also a cast idol

H5263.d: a primitive root; to wane, i.e. be sick

H5264.d: a primitive root; to gleam from afar, i.e. to be conspicuous as a signal; or rather perhaps a denominative from H5251 (נֵס) (and identical with H5263 (נָסַס), through the idea of a flag as fluttering in the wind); to raise a beacon

H5265.d: a primitive root; properly, to pull up, especially the tent-pins, i.e. start on ajourney

H6078.d: from an unused noun (denoting a place in Palestine; from an unused root of uncertain meaning); an Ophnite (collectively) or inhabitants of Ophen

H6079.d: from H5774 (עוּף); an eyelash (as fluttering); figuratively, morning ray

H6080.d: ; a primitive root; meaning either to be gray or perhaps rather to pulverize; used only as denominative from H6083 (עָפָר), to be dust

H6081.d: probably a variation of H6082 (עֹפֶר); gazelle; Epher, the name of an Arabian and of two Israelites

H6082.d: from H6080 (עָפַר); a fawn (from the dusty color)

H6083.d: from H6080 (עָפַר); dust (as powdered or gray); hence, clay, earth, mud

H6085.d: from the same as H6081 (עֵפֶר); fawn-like; Ephron, the name of a Canaanite and of two places in Palestine

H6086.d: from H6095 (עָצָה); a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)

H6087.d: a primitive root; properly, to carve, i.e. fabricate or fashion; hence (in a bad sense) to worry, pain or anger

H6094.d: from H6087 (עָצַב); a idol; also, a pain or wound

H6095.d: a primitive root; properly, to fasten (or make firm), i.e. to close (the eyes)

H6096.d: from H6095 (עָצָה); the spine (as giving firmness to the body)

H6098.d: from H3289 (יָעַץ); advice; by implication, plan; also prudence

H6099.d: or עָצֻם; passive participle of H6105 (עָצַם); powerful (specifically, a paw); by implication, numerous

H6100.d: from H6096 (עָצֶה) and H1397 (גֶּבֶר); backbone-like of a man; Etsjon-Geber, a place on the Red Sea

H6106.d: from H6105 (עָצַם); a bone (as strong); by extension, the body; figuratively, the substance, i.e. (as pron.) selfsame
H6106.k: body, bone, [idiom] life, (self-) same, strength, [idiom] very.

H6107.d: the same as H6106 (עֶצֶם); bone; Etsem, a place in Palestine

H6109.d: feminine of H6108 (עֹצֶם); powerfulness; by extension, numerousness

H6110.d: feminine of H6099 (עָצוּם); a bulwark, i.e. (figuratively) argument

H6111.d: or עַצְמֹן; from H6107 (עֶצֶם); bone-like; Atsmon, a place near Palestine

H6112.d: from an unused root meaning to be sharp or strong; a spear

H6113.d: a primitive root; to inclose; by analogy, to hold back; also to maintain, rule, assemble
H6113.k: [idiom] be able, close up, detain, fast, keep (self close, still), prevail, recover, refrain, [idiom] reign, restrain, retain, shut (up), slack, stay, stop, withhold (self).

H6116.d: or עֲצֶרֶת; from H6113 (עָצָר); an assembly, especially on afestival or holiday

H6117.d: a primitive root; properly, to swell out or up; used only as denominative from H6119 (עָקֵב), to seize by the heel; figuratively, to circumvent (as if tripping up the heels); also to restrain (as if holding by the heel)
H6117.k: take by the heel, stay, supplant, [idiom] utterly.

H6121.d: from H6117 (עָקַב); in the original sense, a knoll (as swelling up); in the denominative sense (transitive) fraudulent or (intransitive) tracked

H6122.d: feminine of an unused form from H6117 (עָקַב) meaning a trick; trickery

H6123.d: a primitive root; to tie with thongs

H6126.d: from H6117 (עָקַב); insidious; Akkub, the name of five Israelites

H6130.d: from an unused root meaning to twist; tortuous; Akan, an Idummaean

H6134.d: the same as H6133 (עֵקֶר); Eker, an Israelite

H6135.d: from H6131 (עָקַר); sterile (as if extirpated in the generative organs)

H6137.d: of uncertain derivation; a scorpion; figuratively, a scourge or knotted whip

H6138.d: from H6131 (עָקַר); eradication; Ekron, a place in Palestine

H6139.d: or עֶקְרֹנִי; patrial from H6138 (עֶקְרוֹן); an Ekronite or inhabitant of Ekron

H6140.d: a primitive root; to knot or distort; figuratively, to pervert (act or declare perverse)

H6142.d: the same as H6141 (עִקֵּשׁ); perverse; Ikkesh, an Israelite

H6144.d: the same as H5892 (עִיר); a city; Ar, a place in Moab

H6145.d: from H5782 (עוּר); a foe (as watchful for mischief)

H6146.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H6145 (עָר) {a foe (as watchful for mischief)}

H6147.d: from H5782 (עוּר); watchful; Er, the name of two Israelites

H6148.d: a primitive root; to braid, i.e. intermix; technically, to traffic (as if by barter); also or give to be security (as a kind of exchange)
H6148.k: engage, (inter-) meddle (with), mingle (self), mortgage, occupy, give pledges, be(-come, put in) surety, undertake.

H6149.d: a primitive root (rather identical with H6148 (עָרַב) through the idea of close association); to be agreeable
H6149.k: be pleasant(-ing), take pleasure in, be sweet.

H6150.d: a primitive root (rather identical with H6148 (עָרַב) through the idea of covering with a texture); to grow dusky at sundown

H6154.d: or עֶרֶב; (1 Kings 10:15), (with the article [prefix), from H6148 (עָרַב); the web (or transverse threads of cloth); also a mixture, (or mongrel race)

H6155.d: from H6148 (עָרַב); a willow (from the use of osiers as wattles)

H6157.d: from H6148 (עָרַב); a mosquito (from its swarming)

H6158.d: or עוֹרֵב; from H6150 (עָרַב); a raven (from its dusky hue)

H6159.d: or עוֹרֵב; the same as H6158 (עֹרֵב); Oreb, the name of a Midianite and of the cliff near the Jordan

H6162.d: from H6148 (עָרַב) (in the sense of exchange); a pawn (given as security)

H6163.d: or עַרְבִי; patrial from H6152 (עֲרָב); an Arabian or inhabitant of Arab (i.e. Arabia)

H6169.d: feminine from H6168 (עָרָה); a naked (i.e. level) plot

H6170.d: or עֲרֻגָה; feminine passive participle of H6165 (עָרַג); something piled up (as if (figuratively) raised by mental aspiration), i.e. a paterre

H6171.d: from the same as H6166 (עֲרָד); an onager (from his lonesome habits)

H6172.d: from H6168 (עָרָה); nudity, literally (especially the pudenda) or figuratively (disgrace, blemish)

H6173.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H6172 (עֶרְוָה); nakedness, i.e. (figuratively) impoverishment

H6174.d: or עָרֹם; from H6191 (עָרַם) (in its original sense); nude, either partially or totally

H6175.d: passive participle of H6191 (עָרַם); cunning (usually in a bad sense)

H6176.d: or עַרְעָר; from H6209 (עָרַר) reduplicated; a juniper (from its nudity of situation)

H6177.d: or עֲרֹעֵר; or עַרְעוֹר; the same as H6176 (עֲרוֹעֵר); nudity of situation; Aroer, the name of three places in or near Palestine

H6182.d: from an unused root meaning to comminute; meal

H6184.d: from H6206 (עָרַץ); fearful, i.e. powerful or tyrannical

H6185.d: from H6209 (עָרַר); bare, i.e. destitute (of children)

H6192.d: a primitive root; to pile up

H6194.d: (Jeremiah 50:26) or (feminine) עֲרֵמָה; from H6192 (עָרַם); a heap; specifically, a sheaf

H6195.d: feminine of H6193 (עֹרֶם); trickery; or (in a good sense) discretion

H6196.d: probably from H6191 (עָרַם); the plane tree (from its smooth and shed bark)

H6197.d: probably from H5782 (עוּר); watchful; Eran, an Israelite

H6198.d: patronymically from H6197 (עֵרָן); an Eranite or descendant (collectively) of Eran

H6200.d: patronymically from H6177 (עֲרוֹעֵר); an Aroerite or inhabitant of Aroer

H6201.d: a primitive root; to droop; hence, to drip

H6203.d: from H6202 (עָרַף); the nape or back of the neck (as declining); hence, the back generally (whether literal or figurative)

H6204.d: feminine of H6203 (עֹרֶף); mane; Orpah, a Moabites

H6205.d: probably from H6201 (עָרַף); gloom (as of a lowering sky)

H6206.d: a primitive root; to awe or (intransitive) to dread; hence, to harass
H6206.k: be affrighted (afraid, dread, feared, terrified), break, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, shake terribly.

H6207.d: a primitive root; to gnaw, i.e. (figuratively) eat (by hyberbole); also (participle) a pain

H6208.d: patrial from an unused name meaning a tush; an Arkite or inhabitant of Erek

H6209.d: a primitive root; to bare; figuratively, to demolish
H6209.k: make bare, break, raise up (perhaps by clerical error for raze), [idiom] utterly.

H6210.d: from an unused root meaning perhaps to arch; a couch (properly, with a canopy)

H6212.d: from an unused root meaning to glisten (or be green); grass (or any tender shoot)

H6213.d: a primitive root; to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application

H6216.d: from H6231 (עָשַׁק); oppressive (as noun, a tyrant)

H6218.d: or עָשֹׂר; from H6235 (עֶשֶׂר); ten; by abbreviated form ten strings, and so a decachord

H6220.d: for H6219 (עָשׁוֹת); bright; Ashvath, an Israelite

H6221.d: from H6213 (עָשָׂה) and H410 (אֵל); made of God; Asiel, an Israelite

H6222.d: from H6213 (עָשָׂה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has made; Asajah, the name of three or four Israelites

H6223.d: from H6238 (עָשַׁר); rich, whether literal or figurative (noble)

H6224.d: from H6235 (עֶשֶׂר); tenth; by abbreviation, tenth month or (feminine) part

H6225.d: a primitive root; to smoke, whether literal or figurative

H6227.d: from H6225 (עָשַׁן); smoke, literally or figuratively (vapor, dust, anger)

H6228.d: the same as H6227 (עָשָׁן); Ashan, a place in Palestine

H6229.d: a primitive root (identical with H6231 (עָשַׁק)); to press upon, i.e. quarrel

H6231.k: get deceitfully, deceive, defraud, drink up, (use) oppress(-ion), -or), do violence (wrong).

H6232.d: from H6231 (עָשַׁק); oppression; Eshek, an Israelite

H6233.d: from H6231 (עָשַׁק); injury, fraud, (subjectively) distress, (concretely) unjust gain

H6235.d: masculine of term עֲשָׂרָה; from H6237 (עָשַׂר); ten (as an accumulation to the extent of the digits)

H6236.d: (Aramaic) masculine עֲשְׂרָה (Aramaic); corresponding to H6235 (עֶשֶׂר); ten

H6237.d: a primitive root (identical with H6238 (עָשַׁר)); to accumulate; but used only as denominative from H6235 (עֶשֶׂר); to tithe, i.e. to take or give atenth
H6237.k: [idiom] surely, give (take) the tenth, (have, take) tithe(-ing, -s), [idiom] truly.

H6238.k: be(-come, en-, make, make self, wax) rich, make (1 Kings 22:48 marg). See H6240 (עָשָׂר).

H6240.k: (eigh-, fif-, four-, nine-, seven-, six-, thir-) teen(-th), [phrase] eleven(-th), [phrase] sixscore thousand, [phrase] twelve(-th).

H6241.d: or עִשָּׂרֹן; from H6235 (עֶשֶׂר); (fractional) a tenth part

H6254.d: patrial from H6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת); an Ashterathite or inhabitant of Ashtaroth

H6255.d: from H6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת) and the dual of H7161 (קֶרֶן); Ashtaroth of (the) double horns (a symbol of the deity); Ashteroth-Karnaim, a place East of the Jordan

H6256.d: from H5703 (עַד); time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.

H6258.d: from H6256 (עֵת); at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive
H6258.k: henceforth, now, straightway, this time, whereas.

H6260.d: or עַתֻּד; from H6257 (עָתַד); prepared, i.e. full grown; spoken only (in plural) of he-goats, or (figuratively) leaders of the people

H6262.d: for H6261 (עִתִּי); Attai, the name of three Israelites

H6264.d: from H6257 (עָתַד); prepared; by implication, skilful; feminine plural the future; also treasure
H6264.k: things that shall come, ready, treasures.

H6265.d: from H5790 (עוּת) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has helped; Athajah, an Israelite

H6266.d: from H6275 (עָתַק); properly, antique, i.e. venerable or splendid

H6267.d: from H6275 (עָתַק); removed, i.e. weaned; also antique

H6269.d: from an unused root meaning to sojourn; lodging; Athak, a place in Palestine

H6272.d: a primitive root; probably to glow, i.e. (figuratively) be desolated

H6273.d: from an unused root meaning to force; forcible; Othni, an Israelite

H6274.d: from the same as H6273 (עׇתְנִי) and H410 (אֵל); force of God; Othniel, an Israelite

H6275.d: a primitive root; to remove (intransitive or transitive) figuratively, to grow old; specifically, to transcribe
H6275.k: copy out, leave off, become (wax) old, remove.

H6277.d: from H6275 (עָתַק) in the sense of license; impudent

H6278.d: from H6256 (עֵת) and H7011 (קַיָּם); time of a judge; Eth-Katsin, a place in Palestine

H6279.d: a primitive root (rather denominative from H6281 (עֶתֶר)); to burn incense in worship, i.e. intercede (reciprocally, listen to prayer)

H6280.d: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) abundant

H6281.d: from H6280 (עָתַר); abundance; Ether, a place in Palestine

H6282.d: from H6280 (עָתַר); also compare H6279 (עָתַר) incense (as increasing to a volume of smoke); hence a worshipper

H6284.d: a primitive root; to puff, i.e. blow away

H6285.d: feminine of H6311 (פֹּה); properly, mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction, region, extremity

H6286.d: a primitive root; also denominative from H6288 (פְּאֹרָה), to gleam, i.e. (causatively) embellish; figuratively, to boast; also to explain (i.e. make clear) oneself; to shake a tree

G3679.d: from G3681 (ὄνειδος); to defame, i.e. rail at, chide, taunt
G3679.k: cast in teeth, (suffer) reproach, revile, upbraid

G3681.d: probably akin to the base of G3686 (ὄνομα); notoriety, i.e. a taunt (disgrace)

G3682.d: from G3685 (ὀνίνημι); profitable; Onesimus, a Christian

G3683.d: from a derivative of G3685 (ὀνίνημι) and G5411 (φόρος); profit-bearer; Onesiphorus, a Christian

G3684.d: from G3688 (ὄνος); belonging to a ass, i.e. large (so as to be turned by a ass)

G3685.d: a prolonged form of an apparently primary verb (, to slur); for which another prolonged form () is used as an alternate in some tenses (unless indeed it be identical with the base of G3686 (ὄνομα) through the idea of notoriety); to gratify, i.e. (middle voice) to derive pleasure or advantage from

G3686.d: from a presumed derivative of the base of G1097 (γινώσκω) (compare G3685 (ὀνίνημι)); a "name" (literally or figuratively) (authority, character)

G3687.d: from G3686 (ὄνομα); to name, i.e. assign an appellation; by extension, to utter, mention, profess

G3688.d: apparently a primary word; a donkey

G3689.d: adverb of the oblique cases of G5607 (ὤν); really
G3689.k: certainly, clean, indeed, of a truth, verily

G3690.d: from G3691 (ὀξύς); vinegar, i.e. sour wine

G3691.d: probably akin to the base of G188 (ἀκμήν) ("acid"); keen; by analogy, rapid

G3692.d: probably from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι); a hole (as if for light), i.e. cavern; by analogy, a spring (of water)

G3693.d: from (regard; from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι)) with enclitic of source; from the rear (as a secure aspect), i.e. at the back (adverb and preposition of place or time)

G3694.d: from the same as G3693 (ὄπισθεν) with enclitic of direction; to the back, i.e. aback (as adverb or preposition of time or place; or as noun)

G3695.d: from G3696 (ὅπλον); to equip (with weapons (middle voice and figuratively))

G3696.d: probably from a primary (to be busy about); an implement or utensil or tool (literally or figuratively, especially, offensive for war)

G3697.d: from G3739 (ὅς) and G4169 (ποῖος); of what kind that, i.e. how (as) great (excellent) (specially, as an indefinite correlative to the definite antecedent G5108 (τοιοῦτος) of quality)
G3697.k: what manner (sort) of, such as whatsoever

G3698.d: from G3739 (ὅς) and G4218 (ποτέ); what(-ever) then, i.e. (of time) as soon as

G3699.d: from G3739 (ὅς) and G4225 (πού); what(-ever) where, i.e. at whichever spot
G3699.k: in what place, where(-as, -soever), whither (+ soever)

G3700.d: a (middle voice) prolonged form of the primary (middle voice) ; which is used for it in certain tenses; and both as alternate of G3708 (ὁράω); to gaze (i.e. with wide-open eyes, as at something remarkable; and thus differing from G991 (βλέπω), which denotes simply voluntary observation; and from G1492 (εἴδω), which expresses merely mechanical, passive or casual vision; while G2300 (θεάομαι), and still more emphatically its intensive G2334 (θεωρέω), signifies an earnest but more continued inspection; and G4648 (σκοπέω) a watching from a distance)

G3701.d: from a presumed derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι); visuality, i.e. (concretely) an apparition

G3702.d: from an obsolete verb akin to (to "steep"); cooked, i.e. roasted

G3703.d: apparently from the base of G3796 (ὀψέ) and G5610 (ὥρα); properly, even-tide of the (summer) season (dog-days), i.e. (by implication) ripe fruit

G3704.d: from G3739 (ὅς) and G4459 (πῶς); what(-ever) how, i.e. in the manner that (as adverb or conjunction of coincidence, intentional or actual)

G3705.d: from G3708 (ὁράω); something gazed at, i.e. a spectacle (especially supernatural)

G3706.d: from G3708 (ὁράω); the act of gazing, i.e. (externally) an aspect or (internally) an inspired appearance

G3707.d: from G3708 (ὁράω); gazed at, i.e. (by implication) capable of being seen

G3708.d: properly, to stare at (compare G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι)), i.e. (by implication) to discern clearly (physically or mentally); by extension, to attend to; by Hebraism, to experience; passively, to appear

G3709.d: from G3713 (ὀρέγομαι); properly, desire (as a reaching forth or excitement of the mind), i.e. (by analogy), violent passion (ire, or (justifiable) abhorrence); by implication punishment

G3710.d: from G3709 (ὀργή); to provoke or enrage, i.e. (passively) become exasperated

G3712.d: from G3713 (ὀρέγομαι); a stretch of the arms, i.e. a fathom

G3713.d: middle voice of apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary (compare G3735 (ὄρος)); to stretch oneself, i.e. reach out after (long for)

G3714.d: from G3735 (ὄρος); mountainous, i.e. (feminine by implication, of G5561 (χώρα)) the Highlands (of Judæa)

G3715.d: from G3713 (ὀρέγομαι); excitement of the mind, i.e. longing after

G3716.d: from a compound of G3717 (ὀρθός) and G4228 (πούς); to be straight-footed, i.e. (figuratively) to go directly forward

G3717.d: probably from the base of G3735 (ὄρος); right (as rising), i.e. (perpendicularly) erect (figuratively, honest), or (horizontally) level or direct

G3718.d: from a compound of G3717 (ὀρθός) and the base of G5114 (τομώτερος), to make a straight cut, i.e. (figuratively) to dissect (expound) correctly (the divine message)

G3719.d: from G3722 (ὄρθρος); to use the dawn, i.e. (by implication) to repair betimes

G3720.d: from G3722 (ὄρθρος); relating to the dawn, i.e. matutinal (as an epithet of Venus, especially brilliant in the early day)

G3721.d: from G3722 (ὄρθρος); in the dawn, i.e. up at day-break

G3722.d: from the same as G3735 (ὄρος); dawn (as sun-rise, rising of light); by extension, morn

G3723.d: adverb from G3717 (ὀρθός); in a straight manner, i.e. (figuratively) correctly (also morally)

G3724.d: from G3725 (ὅριον); to mark out or bound ("horizon"), i.e. (figuratively) to appoint, decree, specify

G3725.d: neuter of a derivative of an apparently primary (a bound or limit); a boundary-line, i.e. (by implication) a frontier (region)

G3726.d: from G3727 (ὅρκος); to put on oath, i.e. make swear; by analogy, to solemnly enjoin

G3727.d: from (a fence; perhaps akin to G3725 (ὅριον)); a limit, i.e. (sacred) restraint (specially, an oath)

G3728.d: from a compound of G3727 (ὅρκος) and a derivative of G3660 (ὀμνύω); asseveration on oath

G3729.d: from G3730 (ὁρμή); to start, spur or urge on, i.e. (reflexively) to dash or plunge

G3730.d: of uncertain affinity; a violent impulse, i.e. onset

G3731.d: from G3730 (ὁρμή); an attack, i.e. (abstractly) precipitancy

G3732.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of G3733 (ὄρνις); a birdling

G3733.d: probably from a prolonged form of the base of G3735 (ὄρος); a bird (as rising in the air), i.e. (specially), a hen (or female domestic fowl)

G3734.d: from a compound of the base of G3725 (ὅριον) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι); a limit-placing, i.e. (concretely) boundary-line

G3735.d: probably from an obsolete (to rise or "rear"; perhaps akin to G142 (αἴρω); compare G3733 (ὄρνις)); a mountain (as lifting itself above the plain)

G3736.d: apparently a primary verb; to "burrow" in the ground, i.e. dig

G3737.d: of uncertain affinity; bereaved ("orphan"), i.e. parentless

G3738.d: middle voice from (a row or ring); to dance (from the ranklike or regular motion)

G3739.d: probably a primary word (or perhaps a form of the article G3588 (ὁ)); the relatively (sometimes demonstrative) pronoun, who, which, what, that
G3739.k: one, (an-, the) other, some, that, what, which, who(-m, -se), etc

G3740.d: multiple adverb from G3739 (ὅς); how (i.e. with G302 (ἄν), so) many times as

G3741.d: of uncertain affinity; properly, right (by intrinsic or divine character; thus distinguished from 1342, which refers rather to human statutes and relations; from G2413 (ἱερός), which denotes formal consecration; and from G40 (ἅγιος), which relates to purity from defilement), i.e. hallowed (pious, sacred, sure)

G3745.d: by reduplication from G3739 (ὅς); as (much, great, long, etc.) as
G3745.k: all (that), as (long, many, much) (as), how great (many, much), (in-)asmuch as, so many as, that (ever), the more, those things, what (great, -soever), wheresoever, wherewithsoever, which, X while, who(-soever)

G3746.d: from G3739 (ὅς) and G4007 (περ); who especially

G3748.d: from G3739 (ὅς) and G5100 (τὶς); which some, i.e. any that; also (definite) which same
G3748.k: X and (they), (such) as, (they) that, in that they, what(-soever), whereas ye, (they) which, who(-soever)

G3749.d: from ("oyster") (a tile, i.e. terra cotta); earthen-ware, i.e. clayey; by implication, frail

G3750.d: from a derivative of G3605 (ὄζω); smell (the sense)

G3751.d: of uncertain affinity; the loin (externally), i.e. the hip; internally (by extension) procreative power

G3752.d: from G3753 (ὅτε) and G302 (ἄν); whenever (implying hypothesis or more or less uncertainty); also causatively (conjunctionally) inasmuch as
G3752.k: as long (soon) as, that, + till, when(-soever), while

G3753.d: from G3739 (ὅς) and G5037 (τέ); at which (thing) too, i.e. when
G3753.k: after (that), as soon as, that, when, while

G3754.d: neuter of G3748 (ὅστις) as conjunction; demonstrative, that (sometimes redundant); causative, because
G3754.k: as concerning that, as though, because (that), for (that), how (that), (in) that, though, why

G3755.d: for the genitive case of G3748 (ὅστις) (as adverb); during which same time, i.e. whilst

G3756.d: a primary word; the absolute negative (compare G3361 (μή)) adverb; no or not
G3756.k: + long, nay, neither, never, no (X man), none, (can-)not, + nothing, + special, un(-worthy), when, + without, + yet but

G3757.d: genitive case of G3739 (ὅς) as adverb; at which place, i.e. where

G3760.d: adverb from (the feminine) of G3762 (οὐδείς); by no means

G3761.d: from G3756 (οὐ) and G1161 (δέ); not however, i.e. neither, nor, not even
G3761.k: neither (indeed), never, no (more, nor, not), nor (yet), (also, even, then) not (even, so much as), + nothing, so much as

G3762.d: from G3761 (οὐδέ) and G1520 (εἷς); not even one (man, woman or thing), i.e. none, nobody, nothing
G3762.k: any (man), aught, man, neither any (thing), never (man), no (man), none (+ of these things), not (any, at all, -thing), nought

G3763.d: from G3761 (οὐδέ) and G4218 (ποτέ); not even at any time, i.e. never at all
G3763.k: neither at any time, never, nothing at any time

G3764.d: from G3761 (οὐδέ) and G4452 (-πω); not even yet
G3764.k: as yet not, never before (yet), (not) yet

G3765.d: from G3756 (οὐ) and G2089 (ἔτι); not yet, no longer
G3765.k: after that (not), (not) any more, henceforth (hereafter) not, no longer (more), not as yet (now), now no more (not), yet (not)

G3766.d: from G3756 (οὐ) and G3767 (οὖν); is it not therefore that, i.e. (affirmatively) hence or so

G3767.d: apparently a primary word; (adverbially) certainly, or (conjunctionally) accordingly
G3767.k: and (so, truly), but, now (then), so (likewise then), then, therefore, verily, wherefore

G3768.d: from G3756 (οὐ) and G4452 (-πω); not yet
G3768.k: hitherto not, (no…) as yet, not yet

G3769.d: apparently a primary word; a tail

G3770.d: from G3772 (οὐρανός); celestial, i.e. belonging to or coming from the sky

G3771.d: from G3772 (οὐρανός) and the enclitic of source; from the sky

G3772.d: perhaps from the same as G3735 (ὄρος) (through the idea of elevation); the sky; by extension, heaven (as the abode of God); by implication, happiness, power, eternity; specially, the Gospel (Christianity)

G3773.d: of Latin origin; Urbanus (of the city, "urbane"), a Christian

G3774.d: of Hebrew origin (H0223); Urias (i.e. Urijah), a Hittite

G3775.d: apparently a primary word; the ear (physically or mentally)

G3776.d: from the feminine of G5607 (ὤν); substance, i.e. property (possessions)

G3777.d: from G3756 (οὐ) and G5037 (τέ); not too, i.e. neither or nor; by analogy, not even
G3777.k: neither, none, nor (yet), (no, yet) not, nothing

G3778.d: from the article G3588 (ὁ) and G846 (αὐτός); the he (she or it), i.e. this or that (often with article repeated)
G3778.k: he (it was that), hereof, it, she, such as, the same, these, they, this (man, same, woman), which, who

G3779.d: adverb from G3778 (οὗτος); in this way (referring to what precedes or follows)
G3779.k: after that, after (in) this manner, as, even (so), for all that, like(-wise), no more, on this fashion(-wise), so (in like manner), thus, what

G3781.d: from G3784 (ὀφείλω); an ower, i.e. person indebted; figuratively, a delinquent; morally, a transgressor (against God)

G3782.d: from G3784 (ὀφείλω); indebtedness, i.e. (concretely) a sum owed; figuratively, obligation, i.e. (conjugal) duty

G3783.d: from (the alternate of) G3784 (ὀφείλω); something owed, i.e. (figuratively) a due; morally, a fault

G3784.d: probably from the base of G3786 (ὄφελος) (through the idea of accruing); to owe (pecuniarily); figuratively, to be under obligation (ought, must, should); morally, to fail in duty
G3784.k: behove, be bound, (be) debt(-or), (be) due(-ty), be guilty (indebted), (must) need(-s), ought, owe, should

G3785.d: first person singular of a past tense of G3784 (ὀφείλω); I ought (wish), i.e. (interjection) oh that!

G3786.d: from (to heap up, i.e. accumulate or benefit); gain

G3787.d: from G3788 (ὀφθαλμός) and G1397 (δουλεία); sight-labor, i.e. that needs watching (remissness)

G3788.d: from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι); the eye (literally or figuratively); by implication, vision; figuratively, envy (from the jealous side-glance)

G3789.d: probably from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι) (through the idea of sharpness of vision); a snake, figuratively, (as a type of sly cunning) an artful malicious person, especially Satan

G3790.d: perhaps from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι) (through the idea of the shading or proximity to the organ of vision); the eye-"brow" or forehead, i.e. (figuratively) the brink of a precipice

G3791.d: from G3793 (ὄχλος); to mob, i.e. (by implication) to harass

G3792.d: from G3793 (ὄχλος) and G4160 (ποιέω); to make a crowd, i.e. raise a public disturbance

G3793.d: from a derivative of G2192 (ἔχω) (meaning a vehicle); a throng (as borne along); by implication, the rabble; by extension, a class of people; figuratively, a riot
G3793.k: company, multitude, number (of people), people, press

G3794.d: from a remote derivative of G2192 (ἔχω) (meaning to fortify, through the idea of holding safely); a castle (figuratively, argument)

G3795.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of G3702 (ὀπτός); a relish to other food (as if cooked sauce), i.e. (specially), fish (presumably salted and dried as a condiment)

G3796.d: from the same as G3694 (ὀπίσω) (through the idea of backwardness); (adverbially) late in the day; by extension, after the close of the day

G3798.d: from G3796 (ὀψέ); late; feminine (as noun) afternoon (early eve) or nightfall (later eve)

G3799.d: from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι); properly, sight (the act), i.e. (by implication) the visage, an external show

G3800.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of the same as G3795 (ὀψάριον); rations for a soldier, i.e. (by extension) his stipend or pay

G3801.w: ὁ ὢν καί ὁ ἦν καί ὁ ἐρχόμενος
G3801.x: ho ṑn kaí ho ēn kaí ho erchómenos
G3801.d: a phrase combining G3588 (ὁ) with the present participle and imperfect of G1510 (εἰμί) and the present participle of G2064 (ἔρχομαι) by means of G2532 (καί); the one being and the one that was and the one coming, i.e. the Eternal, as a divine epithet of Christ
G3801.k: which art (is, was), and (which) wast (is, was), and art (is) to come (shalt be)

G3803.d: from G4078 (πήγνυμι); a trap (as fastened by a noose or notch); figuratively, a trick or statagem (temptation)

G3804.d: from a presumed derivative of G3806 (πάθος); something undergone, i.e. hardship or pain; subjectively, an emotion or influence

G3805.d: from the same as G3804 (πάθημα); liable (i.e. doomed) to experience pain

G3806.d: from the alternate of G3958 (πάσχω); properly, suffering ("pathos"), i.e. (subjectively) a passion (especially concupiscence)

G3807.d: from G3816 (παῖς) and a reduplicated form of G71 (ἄγω); a boy-leader, i.e. a servant whose office it was to take the children to school; (by implication, (figuratively) a tutor ("pædagogue"))

G3808.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of G3816 (παῖς); a little boy

G3809.d: from G3811 (παιδεύω); tutorage, i.e. education or training; by implication, disciplinary correction

G3810.d: from G3811 (παιδεύω); a trainer, i.e. teacher or (by implication) discipliner

G3811.d: from G3816 (παῖς); to train up a child, i.e. educate, or (by implication), discipline (by punishment)

G3812.d: adverb (of source) from G3813 (παιδίον); from infancy

G3813.d: neuter diminutive of G3816 (παῖς); a childling (of either sex), i.e. (properly), an infant, or (by extension) a half-grown boy or girl; figuratively, an immature Christian

G3814.d: feminine diminutive of G3816 (παῖς); a girl, i.e. (specially), a female slave or servant

G3815.d: from G3816 (παῖς); to sport (as a boy)

G3816.d: perhaps from G3817 (παίω); a boy (as often beaten with impunity), or (by analogy), a girl, and (genitive case) a child; specially, a slave or servant (especially a minister to a king; and by eminence to God)
G3816.k: child, maid(-en), (man) servant, son, young man

G3817.d: a primary verb; to hit (as if by a single blow and less violently than G5180 (τύπτω)); specially, to sting (as a scorpion)

G3818.d: feminine of an adjective of uncertain derivation; Pacatianian, a section of Phrygia

G3819.d: probably another form for G3825 (πάλιν) (through the idea of retrocession); (adverbially) formerly, or (by relatively) sometime since; (elliptically as adjective) ancient
G3819.k: any while, a great while ago, (of) old, in time past

G3820.d: from G3819 (πάλαι); antique, i.e. not recent, worn out

G3822.d: from G3820 (παλαιός); to make (passively, become) worn out, or declare obsolete

G3823.d: from (to vibrate; another form for G906 (βάλλω)); wrestling

G3824.d: from G3825 (πάλιν) and G1078 (γένεσις); (spiritual) rebirth (the state or the act), i.e. (figuratively) spiritual renovation; specially, Messianic restoration

G3825.d: probably from the same as G3823 (πάλη) (through the idea of oscillatory repetition); (adverbially) anew, i.e. (of place) back, (of time) once more, or (conjunctionally) furthermore or on the other hand

G3826.d: dative case (adverb) of a compound of G3956 (πᾶς) and G4128 (πλῆθος); in full multitude, i.e. concertedly or simultaneously

G3827.d: from G3956 (πᾶς) and G4183 (πολύς); full many, i.e. immense

G3828.d: from a compound of G3956 (πᾶς) and G4443 (πυρά); every-tribal, i.e. heterogeneous (G5561 (χώρα) being implied); Pamphylia, a region of Asia Minor

G3829.d: neuter of a presumed compound of G3956 (πᾶς) and a derivative of G1209 (δέχομαι); all-receptive, i.e. a public lodging-place (caravanserai or khan)

G3830.d: from the same as G3829 (πανδοχεῖον); an innkeeper (warden of a caravanserai)

G3831.d: from G3956 (πᾶς) and a derivative of G58 (ἀγορά); a mass-meeting, i.e. (figuratively) universal companionship

G3832.d: adverb from G3956 (πᾶς) and G3624 (οἶκος); with the whole family

G3833.d: from a compound of G3956 (πᾶς) and G3696 (ὅπλον); full armor ("panoply")

G3834.d: from G3835 (πανοῦργος); adroitness, i.e. (in a bad sense) trickery or sophistry

G3835.d: from G3956 (πᾶς) and G2041 (ἔργον); all-working, i.e. adroit (shrewd)

G3836.d: adverb (of source) from G3837 (πανταχοῦ); from all directions

G3837.d: genitive case (as adverb of place) of a presumed derivative of G3956 (πᾶς); universally

G3838.d: from G3956 (πᾶς) and G5056 (τέλος); full-ended, i.e. entire (neuter as noun, completion)

G3840.d: adverb (of source) from G3956 (πᾶς); from (i.e. on) all sides

G3841.d: from G3956 (πᾶς) and G2904 (κράτος); the all-ruling, i.e. God (as absolute and universal sovereign)

G3842.d: from G3956 (πᾶς) and G3753 (ὅτε); every when, i.e. at all times

G3843.d: adverb from G3956 (πᾶς); entirely; specially, at all events, (with negative, following) in no event
G3843.k: by all means, altogether, at all, needs, no doubt, in (no) wise, surely

G3844.d: a primary preposition; properly, near; i.e. (with genitive case) from beside (literally or figuratively), (with dative case) at (or in) the vicinity of (objectively or subjectively), (with accusative case) to the proximity with (local (especially beyond or opposed to) or causal (on account of)
G3844.k: above, against, among, at, before, by, contrary to, X friend, from, + give (such things as they), + that (she) had, X his, in, more than, nigh unto, (out) of, past, save, side…by, in the sight of, than, (there-)fore, with

G3845.d: from G3844 (παρά) and the base of G939 (βάσις); to go contrary to, i.e. violate a command

G3846.d: from G3844 (παρά) and G906 (βάλλω); to throw alongside, i.e. (reflexively) to reach a place, or (figuratively) to liken

G3849.d: from G3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of G971 (βιάζω); to force contrary to (nature), i.e. compel (by entreaty)

G3850.d: from G3846 (παραβάλλω); a similitude ("parable"), i.e. (symbolic) fictitious narrative (of common life conveying a moral), apothegm or adage

G3851.d: from G3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of G1011 (βουλεύω); to misconsult, i.e. disregard

G3853.d: from G3844 (παρά) and the base of G32 (ἄγγελος); to transmit a message, i.e. (by implication) to enjoin

G3854.d: from G3844 (παρά) and G1096 (γίνομαι); to become near, i.e. approach (have arrived); by implication, to appear publicly

G3855.d: from G3844 (παρά) and G71 (ἄγω); to lead near, i.e. (reflexively or intransitively) to go along or away

G3856.d: from G3844 (παρά) and G1165 (δειγματίζω); to show alongside (the public), i.e. expose to infamy
G3856.k: make a public example, put to an open shame
