G5441.d: from G5442 (φυλάσσω); a watcher or sentry

G5442.d: probably from G5443 (φυλή) through the idea of isolation; to watch, i.e. be on guard (literally of figuratively); by implication, to preserve, obey, avoid

G5443.d: from G5453 (φύω) (compare G5444 (φύλλον)); an offshoot, i.e. race or clan

G5444.d: from the same as G5443 (φυλή); a sprout, i.e. leaf

G5445.d: from a prolonged form of (to mix a liquid with a solid; perhaps akin to G5453 (φύω) through the idea of swelling in bulk), mean to knead; a mass of dough

G5447.d: adverb from G5446 (φυσικός); "physically", i.e. (by implication) instinctively

G5448.d: from G5449 (φύσις) in the primary sense of blowing; to inflate, i.e. (figuratively) make proud (haughty)

G5449.d: from G5453 (φύω); growth (by germination or expansion), i.e. (by implication) natural production (lineal descent); by extension, a genus or sort; figuratively, native disposition, constitution or usage

G5451.d: from G5452 (φυτεύω); trans-planting, i.e. (concretely) a shrub or vegetable

G5452.d: from a derivative of G5453 (φύω); to set out in the earth, i.e. implant; figuratively, to instil doctrine

G5453.d: a primary verb; probably originally, to "puff" or blow, i.e. to swell up; but only used in the implied sense, to germinate or grow (sprout, produce), literally or figuratively

G5454.d: of uncertain derivative; a burrow or lurking-place

G5455.d: from G5456 (φωνή); to emit a sound (animal, human or instrumental); by implication, to address in words or by name, also in imitation

G5456.d: probably akin to G5316 (φαίνω) through the idea of disclosure; a tone (articulate, bestial or artificial); by implication, an address (for any purpose), saying or language

G5457.d: from an obsolete (to shine or make manifest, especially by rays; compare G5316 (φαίνω), G5346 (φημί)); luminousness (in the widest application, natural or artificial, abstract or concrete, literal or figurative)

G5458.d: from G5457 (φῶς); an illuminator, i.e. (concretely) a luminary, or (abstractly) brilliancy

G5459.d: from G5457 (φῶς) and G5342 (φέρω); light-bearing ("phosphorus"), i.e. (specially), the morning-star (figuratively)

G5460.d: from G5457 (φῶς); lustrous, i.e. transparent or well-illuminated (figuratively)

G5461.d: from G5457 (φῶς); to shed rays, i.e. to shine or (transitively) to brighten up (literally or figuratively)
G5461.k: enlighten, illuminate, (bring to, give) light, make to see

G5463.d: a primary verb; to be "cheer"ful, i.e. calmly happy or well-off; impersonally, especially as salutation (on meeting or parting), be well
G5463.k: farewell, be glad, God speed, greeting, hall, joy(- fully), rejoice

G5465.d: from the base of G5490 (χάσμα); to lower (as into a void)

G5466.d: probably of Hebrew or (H03778); a Chaldæan (i.e. Kasdi), or native or the region of the lower Euphrates

G5467.d: perhaps from G5465 (χαλάω) through the idea of reducing the strength; difficult, i.e. dangerous, or (by implication) furious

G5468.d: from a compound of G5469 (χαλινός) and the reduplicated form of G71 (ἄγω); to be a bit-leader, i.e. to curb (figuratively)

G5469.d: from G5465 (χαλάω); a curb or head-stall (as curbing the spirit)

G5471.d: from G5475 (χαλκός); a copper-worker or brazier

G5472.d: from G5475 (χαλκός) and perhaps G1491 (εἶδος); copper-like, i.e. "chalcedony"

G5473.d: diminutive from G5475 (χαλκός); a copper dish

G5474.d: neuter of a compound of G5475 (χαλκός) and G3030 (λίβανος) (in the implied mean of whiteness or brilliancy); burnished copper, an alloy of copper (or gold) and silver having a brilliant lustre

G5475.d: perhaps from G5465 (χαλάω) through the idea of hollowing out as a vessel (this metal being chiefly used for that purpose); copper (the substance, or some implement or coin made of it)

G5476.d: adverb perhaps from the base of G5490 (χάσμα) through the idea of a fissure in the soil; earthward, i.e. prostrate

G5477.d: of Hebrew origin (H03667); Chanaan (i.e. Kenaan), the early name of Palestine

G5478.d: from G5477 (Χαναάν); a Chanaanæan (i.e. Kenaanite), or native of gentile Palestine

G5479.d: from G5463 (χαίρω); cheerfulness, i.e. calm delight
G5479.k: gladness, X greatly, (X be exceeding) joy(-ful, -fully, -fulness, -ous)

G5480.d: from the same as G5482 (χάραξ); a scratch or etching, i.e. stamp (as a badge of servitude), or scupltured figure (statue)

G5481.d: from the same as G5482 (χάραξ); a graver (the tool or the person), i.e. (by implication) engraving (("character"), the figure stamped, i.e. an exact copy or (figuratively) representation)

G5482.d: from (to sharpen to a point; akin to G1125 (γράφω) through the idea of scratching); a stake, i.e. (by implication) a palisade or rampart (military mound for circumvallation in a siege)

G5483.d: middle voice from G5485 (χάρις); to grant as a favor, i.e. gratuitously, in kindness, pardon or rescue

G5484.d: accusative case of G5485 (χάρις) as preposition; through favor of, i.e. on account of
G5484.k: be-(for) cause of, for sake of, +…fore, X reproachfully

G5485.d: from G5463 (χαίρω); graciousness (as gratifying), of manner or act (abstract or concrete; literal, figurative or spiritual; especially the divine influence upon the heart, and its reflection in the life; including gratitude)
G5485.k: acceptable, benefit, favour, gift, grace(- ious), joy, liberality, pleasure, thank(-s, -worthy)

G5486.d: from G5483 (χαρίζομαι); a (divine) gratuity, i.e. deliverance (from danger or passion); (specially), a (spiritual) endowment, i.e. (subjectively) religious qualification, or (objectively) miraculous faculty

G5487.d: from G5485 (χάρις); to grace, i.e. indue with special honor

G5488.d: of Hebrew origin (H02771); Charrhan (i.e. Charan), a place in Mesopotamia

G5489.d: from the same as G5482 (χάραξ); a sheet ("chart") of writing-material (as to be scribbled over)

G5490.d: from a form of an obsolete primary (to "gape" or "yawn"); a "chasm" or vacancy (impassable interval)

G5491.d: from a form of the same as G5490 (χάσμα); a lip (as a pouring place); figuratively, a margin (of water)

G5492.d: from the same as G5494 (χειμών); to storm, i.e. (passively) to labor under a gale

G5493.d: from the base of G5494 (χειμών) and G4482 (ῥέω); a storm-runlet, i.e. winter-torrent

G5494.d: from a derivative of (to pour; akin to the base of 5490 through the idea of a channel), meaning a storm (as pouring rain); by implication, the rainy season, i.e. winter

G5495.d: perhaps from the base of G5494 (χειμών) in the sense of its congener the base of G5490 (χάσμα) (through the idea of hollowness for grasping); the hand (literally or figuratively (power); especially (by Hebraism) a means or instrument)

G5496.d: from G5497 (χειραγωγός); to be a hand-leader, i.e. to guide (a blind person)

G5497.d: from G5495 (χείρ) and a reduplicated form of G71 (ἄγω); a hand-leader, i.e. personal conductor (of a blind person)
G5497.k: some to lead by the hand

G5498.d: neuter of a compound of G5495 (χείρ) and G1125 (γράφω); something hand-written ("chirograph"), i.e. a manuscript (specially, a legal document or bond (figuratively))

G5499.d: from G5495 (χείρ) and a derivative of G4160 (ποιέω); manufactured, i.e. of human construction

G5500.d: from a comparative of G5495 (χείρ) and (to stretch); to be a hand-reacher or voter (by raising the hand), i.e. (generally) to select or appoint

G5501.d: irregular comparative of G2556 (κακός); from an obsolete equivalent (of uncertain derivation); more evil or aggravated (physically, mentally or morally)

G5502.d: plural of Hebrew origin (H03742); "cherubim" (i.e. cherubs or kerubim)

G5503.d: feminine of a presumed derivative apparently from the base of G5490 (χάσμα) through the idea of deficiency; a widow (as lacking a husband), literally or figuratively

G5504.d: of uncertain derivation; "yesterday"; by extension, in time past or hitherto

G5506.d: from G5507 (χίλιοι) and G757 (ἄρχω); the commander of a thousand soldiers ("chiliarch"; i.e. colonel

G5507.d: plural of uncertain affinity; a thousand

G5508.d: of uncertain derivation; Chios, an island in the Mediterranean

G5509.d: of foreign origin (H03801); a tunic or shirt

G5510.d: perhaps akin to the base of G5490 (χάσμα) (G5465 (χαλάω)) or G5494 (χειμών) (as descending or empty); snow

G5511.d: of uncertain derivation; a military cloak

G5512.d: from a derivative probably of G5491 (χεῖλος); to throw out the lip, i.e. jeer at

G5514.d: feminine of apparently a primary word; "green"; Chloë, a Christian female

G5515.d: from the same as G5514 (Χλόη); greenish, i.e. verdant, dun-colored

G5516.d: the 22nd, 14th and an obsolete letter (G4742 (στίγμα) as a cross) of the Greek alphabet (intermediate between the 5th and 6th), used as numbers; denoting respectively 600, 60 and 6; 666 as a numeral

G5517.d: from G5522 (χόος); dusty or dirty (soil-like), i.e. (by implication) terrene

G5518.d: of uncertain derivation; a chœnix or certain dry measure

G5520.d: from G5521 (χολή); to be bilious, i.e. (by implication) irritable (enraged, "choleric")

G5521.d: feminine of an equivalent perhaps akin to the same as 5514 (from the greenish hue); "gall" or bile, i.e. (by analogy) poison or an anodyne (wormwood, poppy, etc.)

G5522.d: from the base of G5494 (χειμών); a heap (as poured out), i.e. rubbish; loose dirt

G5523.d: of uncertain derivation; Chorazin, a place in Palestine

G5524.d: from a compound of G5525 (χορός) and G71 (ἄγω); to be a dance-leader, i.e. (generally) to furnish

G5525.d: of uncertain derivation; a ring, i.e. round dance ("choir"

G5526.d: from G5528 (χόρτος); to fodder, i.e. (generally) to gorge (supply food in abundance)

G5528.d: apparently a primary word; a "court" or "garden", i.e. (by implication, of pasture) herbage or vegetation

G5529.d: of uncertain origin; Chuzas, an officer of Herod

G5530.d: middle voice of a primary verb (perhaps rather from G5495 (χείρ), to handle); to furnish what is needed; (give an oracle, "graze" (touch slightly), light upon, etc.), i.e. (by implication) to employ or (by extension) to act towards one in a given manner

G5531.d: probably the same as the base of G5530 (χράομαι); to loan

G5532.d: from the base of G5530 (χράομαι) or G5534 (χρή); employment, i.e. an affair; also (by implication) occasion, demand, requirement or destitution
G5532.k: business, lack, necessary(-ity), need(-ful), use, want

G5533.d: from a derivative of G5531 (χράω) and G3781 (ὀφειλέτης); a loan-ower, i.e. indebted person

G5534.d: third person singular of the same as G5530 (χράομαι) or G5531 (χράω) used impersonally; it needs (must or should) be

G5535.d: from G5532 (χρεία); to make (i.e. have) necessity, i.e. be in want of

G5536.d: something useful or needed, i.e. wealth, price

G5537.d: from G5536 (χρῆμα); to utter an oracle (compare the original sense of G5530 (χράομαι)), i.e. divinely intimate; by implication, (compare the secular sense of G5532 (χρεία)) to constitute a firm for business, i.e. (generally) bear as a title
G5537.k: be called, be admonished (warned) of God, reveal, speak

G5538.d: from G5537 (χρηματίζω); a divine response or revelation

G5540.d: from G5530 (χράομαι); employment, i.e. (specially), sexual intercourse (as an occupation of the body)

G5541.d: middle voice from G5543 (χρηστός); to show oneself useful, i.e. act benevolently

G5542.d: from a compound of G5543 (χρηστός) and G3004 (λέγω); fair speech, i.e. plausibility

G5543.d: from G5530 (χράομαι); employed, i.e. (by implication) useful (in manner or morals)

G5544.d: from G5543 (χρηστός); usefulness, i.e. morally, excellence (in character or demeanor)

G5545.d: from G5548 (χρίω); an unguent or smearing, i.e. (figuratively) the special endowment ("chrism") of the Holy Spirit

G5546.d: from G5547 (Χριστός); a Christian, i.e. follower of Christ

G5547.d: from G5548 (χρίω); anointed, i.e. the Messiah, an epithet of Jesus

G5548.d: probably akin to G5530 (χράομαι) through the idea of contact; to smear or rub with oil, i.e. (by implication) to consecrate to an office or religious service

G5549.d: from G5550 (χρόνος); to take time, i.e. linger

G5550.d: of uncertain derivation; a space of time (in general, and thus properly distinguished from G2540 (καιρός), which designates a fixed or special occasion; and from G165 (αἰών), which denotes a particular period) or interval; by extension, an individual opportunity; by implication, delay
G5550.k: + years old, season, space, (X often-)time(-s), (a) while

G5551.d: from a presumed compound of G5550 (χρόνος) and the base of G5147 (τρίβος); to be a time-wearer, i.e. to procrastinate (linger)

G5553.d: diminutive of G5557 (χρυσός); a golden article, i.e. gold plating, ornament, or coin

G5554.d: from G5557 (χρυσός) and G1146 (δακτύλιος); gold-ringed, i.e. wearing a golden finger-ring or similar jewelry

G5555.d: from G5557 (χρυσός) and G3037 (λίθος); gold-stone, i.e. a yellow gem ("chrysolite")

G5556.d: from G5557 (χρυσός) and (a leek); a greenish-yellow gem ("chrysoprase")

G5557.d: perhaps from the base of G5530 (χράομαι) (through the idea of the utility of the metal); gold; by extension, a golden article, as an ornament or coin

G5558.d: from G5557 (χρυσός); to gild, i.e. bespangle with golden ornaments

G5559.d: probably akin to the base of G5530 (χράομαι) through the idea of handling; the body (properly, its surface or skin)

G5560.d: apparently a primary word; "halt", i.e. limping

G5561.d: feminine of a derivative of the base of G5490 (χάσμα) through the idea of empty expanse; room, i.e. a space of territory (more or less extensive; often including its inhabitants)
G5561.k: coast, county, fields, ground, land, region

G5562.d: from G5561 (χώρα); to be in (give) space, i.e. (intransitively) to pass, enter, or (transitively) to hold, admit (literally or figuratively)
G5562.k: come, contain, go, have place, (can, be room to) receive

G5563.d: from G5561 (χώρα); to place room between, i.e. part; reflexively, to go away

G5564.d: diminutive of G5561 (χώρα); a spot or plot of ground
G5564.k: field, land, parcel of ground, place, possession

G5565.d: adverb from G5561 (χώρα); at a space, i.e. separately or apart from (often as preposition)

G5566.d: of Latin origin; the north-west wind

G5567.d: probably strengthened from (to rub or touch the surface; compare G5597 (ψώχω)); to twitch or twang, i.e. to play on a stringed instrument (celebrate the divine worship with music and accompanying odes)

G5568.d: from G5567 (ψάλλω); a set piece of music, i.e. a sacred ode (accompanied with the voice, harp or other instrument; a "psalm"); collectively, the book of the Psalms

G5569.d: from G5571 (ψευδής) and G80 (ἀδελφός); a spurious brother, i.e. pretended associate

G5570.d: from G5571 (ψευδής) and G652 (ἀπόστολος); a spurious apostle, i.e. pretended pracher

G5571.d: from G5574 (ψεύδομαι); untrue, i.e. erroneous, deceitful, wicked

G5572.d: from G5571 (ψευδής) and G1320 (διδάσκαλος); a spurious teacher, i.e. propagator of erroneous Christian doctrine

G5573.d: from G5571 (ψευδής) and G3004 (λέγω); mendacious, i.e. promulgating erroneous Christian doctrine

G5574.d: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to utter an untruth or attempt to deceive by falsehood

G5575.d: from G5571 (ψευδής) and a kindred form of G3144 (μάρτυς); a spurious witness, i.e. bearer of untrue testimony

G5576.d: from G5575 (ψευδομάρτυρ); to be an untrue testifier, i.e. offer falsehood in evidence

G5578.d: from G5571 (ψευδής) and G4396 (προφήτης); a spurious prophet, i.e. pretended foreteller or religious impostor

G5580.d: from G5571 (ψευδής) and G5547 (Χριστός); a spurious Messiah

G5581.d: from G5571 (ψευδής) and G3686 (ὄνομα); untruly named

G5582.d: from G5574 (ψεύδομαι); a fabrication, i.e. falsehood

G5584.d: from the base of G5567 (ψάλλω) (compare G5586 (ψῆφος)); to manipulate, i.e. verify by contact; figuratively, to search for

G5585.d: from G5586 (ψῆφος); to use pebbles in enumeration, i.e. (generally) to compute

G5586.d: from the same as G5584 (ψηλαφάω); a pebble (as worn smooth by handling), i.e. (by implication, of use as a counter or ballot) a verdict (of acquittal) or ticket (of admission); a vote

G5587.d: from a derivative of (a whisper; by implication, a slander; probably akin to G5574 (ψεύδομαι)); whispering, i.e. secret detraction

G5588.d: from the same as G5587 (ψιθυρισμός); a secret calumniator

G5589.d: diminutive from a derivative of the base of G5567 (ψάλλω) (meaning a crumb); a little bit or morsel

G5590.d: from G5594 (ψύχω); breath, i.e. (by implication) spirit, abstractly or concretely (the animal sentient principle only; thus distinguished on the one hand from G4151 (πνεῦμα), which is the rational and immortal soul; and on the other from G2222 (ζωή), which is mere vitality, even of plants: these terms thus exactly correspond respectively to the Hebrew H05315, H07307 and H02416)
G5590.k: heart (+ -ily), life, mind, soul, + us, + you

G5591.d: from G5590 (ψυχή); sensitive, i.e. animate (in distinction on the one hand from G4152 (πνευματικός), which is the higher or renovated nature; and on the other from G5446 (φυσικός), which is the lower or bestial nature)

G5594.d: a primary verb; to breathe (voluntarily but gently, thus differing on the one hand from G4154 (πνέω), which denotes properly a forcible respiration; and on the other from the base of G109 (ἀήρ), which refers properly to an inanimate breeze), i.e. (by implication, of reduction of temperature by evaporation) to chill (figuratively)

G5595.d: from the base of G5596 (ψωμίον); to supply with bits, i.e. (generally) to nourish

G5596.d: diminutive from a derivative of the base of G5597 (ψώχω); a crumb or morsel (as if rubbed off), i.e. a mouthful

G5597.d: prolongation from the same base as G5567 (ψάλλω); to triturate, i.e. (by analogy) to rub out (kernels from husks with the fingers or hand)

G5598.d: the last letter of the Greek alphabet, i.e. (figuratively) the finality

G5599.d: a primary interjection; as a sign of the vocative case, O; as a note of exclamation, oh

G5600.d: the subjunctive of G1510 (εἰμί); (may, might, can, could, would, should, must, etc.; also with G1487 (εἰ) and its comparative, as well as with other particles) be
G5600.k: + appear, are, (may, might, should) be, X have, is, + pass the flower of her age, should stand, were

G5601.d: of Hebrew origin (H05744); Obed, an Israelite

G5602.d: from an adverb form of G3592 (ὅδε); in this same spot, i.e. here or hither

G5603.d: from G103 (ᾄδω); a chant or "ode" (the general term for any words sung; while G5215 (ὕμνος) denotes especially a religious metrical composition, and G5568 (ψαλμός) still more specially, a Hebrew cantillation)

G5604.d: akin to G3601 (ὀδύνη); a pang or throe, especially of childbirth

G5605.d: from G5604 (ὠδίν); to experience the pains of parturition (literally or figuratively)

G5606.d: perhaps from the alternate of G5342 (φέρω); the shoulder (as that on which burdens are borne)

G5608.d: middle voice from an apparently primary (a sum or price); to purchase (synonymous with the earlier G4092 (πίμπρημι))

G5610.d: apparently a primary word; an "hour" (literally or figuratively)
G5610.k: day, hour, instant, season, X short, (even-)tide, (high) time

G5611.d: from G5610 (ὥρα); belonging to the right hour or season (timely), i.e. (by implication) flourishing (beauteous (figuratively))

G5612.d: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to "roar"

G5613.d: probably adverb of comparative from G3739 (ὅς); which how, i.e. in that manner (very variously used, as follows)
G5613.k: about, after (that), (according) as (it had been, it were), as soon (as), even as (like), for, how (greatly), like (as, unto), since, so (that), that, to wit, unto, when(-soever), while, X with all speed

G5614.d: of Hebrew origin (H03467 and H04994); oh save!; hosanna (i.e. hoshia-na), an exclamation of adoration

G5615.d: from G5613 (ὡς) and an adverb from G846 (αὐτός); as thus, i.e. in the same way
G5615.k: even so, likewise, after the same (in like) manner

G5616.d: from G5613 (ὡς) and G1487 (εἰ); as if
G5616.k: about, as (it had been, it were), like (as)

G5617.d: of Hebrew origin (H01954); Hosee (i.e. Hoshea), an Israelite

G5618.d: from G5613 (ὡς) and G4007 (περ); just as, i.e. exactly like

G5619.d: from G5618 (ὥσπερ) and G1487 (εἰ); just as if, i.e. as it were

G5620.d: from G5613 (ὡς) and G5037 (τέ); so too, i.e. thus therefore (in various relations of consecution, as follow)
G5620.k: (insomuch) as, so that (then), (insomuch) that, therefore, to, wherefore

G5621.d: diminutive of G3775 (οὖς); an earlet, i.e. one of the ears, or perhaps the lobe of the ear

G5622.d: from a derivative of the base of G5624 (ὠφέλιμος); usefulness, i.e. benefit

G5623.d: from the same as G5622 (ὠφέλεια); to be useful, i.e. to benefit

G5624.d: from a form of G3786 (ὄφελος); helpful or serviceable, i.e. advantageous
